title: An AI-native experimental laboratory for autonomous biomolecular operations

abstract: Developing artificial intelligence (AI)-native experimental laboratories for autonomous scientific exploration with minimal human intervention represents a long-standing goal. Although autonomous experimental systems are emerging1–4, especially in chemical and materials science, they remain largely confined to domains with singular objectives, well-defined workflows and simple instrumentation. This limitation may reflect an ‘add-on’ architecture that uses AI as a task-specific tool rather than providing it with a global understanding of experiments, especially under engineering-oriented circumstances. Here we present AutoDNA, an AI-native autonomous biomolecular engineering laboratory targeting multi-objective experiments across diverse instruments. Through the co-design of models, experiments and instruments, AutoDNA realizes the co-evolution of AI and the automation system within an end-to-end multi-user framework. The system autonomously orchestrates over 20 types of instruments across more than 11,000 steps to execute core nucleic acid operations including synthesis, transcription, amplification and sequencing, while human intervention is limited to hardware maintenance tasks, such as reagent and labware replenishment. Across four representative applications, AutoDNA matched expert-optimized enzymatic DNA synthesis yields, accelerated concurrent protocol execution by 3.2-fold, completed an end-to-end DNA data storage cycle with exact recovery of the original digital content, and identified and validated a clinically detected KRAS G13D mutation. AutoDNA establishes a blueprint towards science-as-a-service, accelerating biological discovery and advancing various applications in synthetic biology and information storage.
zh_abstract: 开发以人工智能（AI）为原生的实验室，使其能够在极少人工干预下进行自主科学探索，是一个长期目标。尽管自主实验系统正在涌现（1–4），尤其是在化学和材料科学领域，但它们在很大程度上仍局限于目标单一、工作流程明确且仪器简单的领域。这一局限可能反映了一种“附加式”架构：即把AI作为特定任务的工具，而不是让其对实验具备全局性理解，尤其是在面向工程的情境下。在此，我们提出AutoDNA，一个AI原生的自主生物分子工程实验室，面向跨多种仪器的多目标实验。通过模型、实验和仪器的协同设计，AutoDNA在端到端的多用户框架内实现了AI与自动化系统的共同进化。该系统可自主编排20余种仪器、执行超过11,000个步骤，完成包括合成、转录、扩增和测序在内的核心核酸操作，而人工干预仅限于硬件维护任务，如补充试剂和耗材。在四项代表性应用中，AutoDNA达到了专家优化的酶促DNA合成产率，将并发方案的执行速度提高了3.2倍，完成了一个端到端的DNA数据存储循环并精确恢复了原始数字内容，并识别和验证了一个临床检出的KRAS G13D突变。AutoDNA为“科学即服务”（science-as-a-service）确立了蓝图，将加速生物学发现，并推动合成生物学和信息存储领域的各类应用。

abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used to evaluate clinical texts, a concept known as LLM-as-a-judge. However, most of the existing evidence focuses on English data and uses pooled agreement metrics that obscure clinically relevant failure modes. This study audited six open-weight models against expert judges on four German clinical datasets covering report and nursing documentation summarization, discharge summary generation, and patient letter generation. The models were evaluated across three paradigms and four prompt configurations. Alignment with experts varied by criterion and corpus, and no configuration proved reliable across paradigms. All judges exhibited position and identity bias. Substituting LLM-as-a-judge for the expert panel shifted 57.2% of pointwise categories, swapped 41.7% of pairwise winners, missed 10.2% of clinical errors, and inverted clinical priorities by overrating the criteria succinct and accurate. Therefore, LLM-as-a-judge is not a safe substitute for experts in German clinical text evaluations, and deployment thresholds should follow decision-impact analysis for LLM-as-a-judge in clinical contexts.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于评估临床文本，这一概念被称为“LLM作为评判者”（LLM-as-a-judge）。然而，现有证据大多集中于英文数据，并使用会掩盖临床相关失效模式的汇总一致性指标。本研究在四个德语临床数据集上，以专家评判者为参照，对六个开放权重模型进行了审计，数据集涵盖报告和护理文书摘要、出院小结生成以及患者信件生成。模型在三种范式和四种提示配置下接受评估。与专家的一致性因评价标准和语料而异，没有任何一种配置在各范式中均表现可靠。所有评判者均表现出位置偏倚和身份偏倚。用LLM评判者替代专家小组后，57.2%的逐点评分类别发生改变，41.7%的成对比较胜者被调换，10.2%的临床错误被漏判，并且因高估“简洁”和“准确”这两项标准而颠倒了临床优先级。因此，在德语临床文本评估中，LLM评判者不能安全地替代专家，在临床情境中部署LLM评判者的阈值应遵循决策影响分析。

abstract: Clinical management of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) requires longitudinal decisions on disease activity, treatment response, and anti-VEGF injection intervals. These decisions depend on integrating multimodal retinal imaging findings across visits, yet manual synthesis is time-consuming and may omit relevant information, limiting transparency and consistency in follow-up planning. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored to summarize longitudinal AMD information, but existing approaches may lack explicit quantitative grounding and evidence attribution, reducing their auditability in clinical decision support. To address these limitations, we developed AMDagent, an evidence-grounded clinical agent that integrates quantitative imaging analysis with guideline retrieval to generate structured, clinician-facing decision-support outputs. The system links longitudinal imaging findings to actionable management considerations while preserving traceable evidence sources. In a 20-case proof-of-concept evaluation of curated longitudinal AMD cases, AMDagent was rated clinically appropriate in 92.0% of predefined decision-support units under expert adjudication. In addition, 83.3% of audited major clinical claims were explicitly grounded in tool-derived quantitative measurements and/or retrieved guideline evidence, enabling clinician verification. These preliminary findings suggest that evidence-grounded, clinician-facing agents may support more transparent and auditable longitudinal AMD decision support, although larger prospective multi-center studies are needed to assess generalizability and clinical utility.

abstract: [JAMA network open] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used to support maternal health, but randomized evidence is limited. To evaluate whether access to a generative AI maternal health chatbot improved 12-month maternal health outcomes. This 2-group randomized clinical trial enrolled 400 participants from October 2023 to December 2024, with 12-month follow-up completed in December 2025. Participants were recruited online across 49 US states and the District of Columbia. Eligible participants were English-speaking, aged 14 years or older, pregnant or parenting an infant younger than 6 months, and self-identified as members of racial and/or ethnic minoritized groups. Participants were randomized 1:1 to receive access to the chatbot or an active control consisting of monthly children's books. Primary outcomes were anxiety and depression symptoms at 12 months measured using the Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 and Patient Health Questionnaire-9. Secondary outcomes included emergency department visits, pregnancy-related complications, postpartum care checkups, effective contraception use, and sleep duration. Among 400 randomized participants, the mean (SD) age was 32.6 (5.1) years; 200 (50%) were parenting an infant at enrollment; and 10 (2%) identified as American Indian or Alaska Native, 80 (20%) Asian, 188 (47%) Black or African American, 57 (14%) multiracial, and 65 (16%) Hispanic or Latino. The AI chatbot was not associated with differences in anxiety scores (adjusted mean difference, 0.10; 95% CI, -0.77 to 0.96) or depression scores (adjusted mean difference, -0.23; 95% CI, -1.05 to 0.59), nor with emergency department visits, postpartum care, contraception use, or sleep duration. Among participants pregnant at enrollment, the chatbot was associated with more self-reported pregnancy-related complications in the secondary 12-month end point analysis, but not in longitudinal analyses. Higher chatbot engagement was associated with longer sleep duration and higher anxiety scores in exploratory within-group analyses. In this randomized clinical trial of pregnant and postpartum individuals from racial and ethnic minoritized groups, access to a generative artificial intelligence maternal health chatbot did not improve maternal anxiety or depression at 12 months compared with an active control. Secondary and exploratory findings should be interpreted cautiously. ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06053515.

abstract: Oncology computed tomography (CT) foundation models require large, high-quality training datasets. However, the collection and annotation of such data are costly and time-consuming because tumors occur across multiple anatomical regions and have complex three-dimensional (3D) structures. Strict privacy constraints and institutional variation further limit the availability of large-scale oncology CT datasets. Here, we propose MedGenAgent, a closed-loop agent that supports oncology CT foundation model pretraining in data-constrained settings by iteratively constructing a lesion-rich, anatomically balanced 3D pretraining dataset. MedGenAgent incorporates a Specification resolver tool for structured task parsing and a central Orchestrator tool to coordinate the entire closed-loop agent workflow by leveraging both an Execution layer (including the MAISI synthesis model node for 3D oncology CT sample synthesis, the MedGemma vision-language model node for automated quality control, and the foundation model training node) and a Memory store tool for iterative, feedback-driven updates. Through the synergy of these tools, MedGenAgent synthesized 11,159 CT samples and retained 11,000 quality-controlled samples. By first leveraging this synthetic dataset for pretraining and then aligning with real-world data using only 4400 DeepLesion samples, representing 38.37% of the data used for baseline pretraining, the MedGenAgent-pretrained foundation model achieved performance comparable to the full-data baseline across three retrospective downstream tasks: lesion anatomical site classification, nodule malignancy classification, and cross-institutional NSCLC overall survival classification. Furthermore, automated quality control, independent physician assessment, and workflow analysis demonstrated the construction of a quality-controlled synthetic CT dataset while revealing regional variation in sample quality. Together, these results show that MedGenAgent can autonomously construct quality-controlled synthetic CT data that support the competitive performance of oncology CT foundation models when annotated real-world data are limited.

We conducted a prospectively registered component network meta-analysis (CNMA) to evaluate their efficacy and safety for non-specific LBP. Six databases and two trial registries were searched to May 2025. Data on disability, pain intensity, and adverse events were analysed using a Bayesian random-effects CNMA. Of 2809 records, 56 reports of 46 studies (6717 participants; 80% chronic low back pain) were included. Hybrid interventions combining digital and in-person exercise with in-person psychological components (MD: –22.21; 95%-CrI: –34.11 to –10.67), digital and in-person exercise (MD: –15.75; 95%-CrI: –22.79 to –8.80), or digital exercise with physiotherapy (MD: –13.17; 95%-CrI: –21.18 to –5.16) reduced disability versus no intervention at short-term (minimal clinically important difference (MCID): 4.92/100 Oswestry Disability Index). Digital and in-person exercise (MD: -1.76; 95%-CrI: -2.62; -0.87) and combined digital exercise training with in-person education (MD: -1.73; 95%-CrI: -2.71; -0.83) improved pain intensity beyond the MCID (0.82/10 numeric pain rating scale). No serious adverse events were noted. Multicomponent hybrid interventions appear safe and may provide clinically meaningful improvements for chronic LBP.

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] The clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) published by the European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) span approximately 1100 pages whose simultaneous cross-referencing is impractical at the point of care. Unguarded large language models (LLMs) carry hallucination risk, motivating a guideline-locked design. We describe the architecture and development of a context-aware clinical agent encompassing the full ESVS corpus of 14 CPGs. The system extends a validated single-guideline GraphRAG prototype with an LLM-driven Guideline Router, an embedded Context Gate that withholds retrieval when decision-critical parameters are absent, dual-channel retrieval, and GPT-5 synthesis under a mandatory citation template. An automated benchmark assessed the final system on 55 vignettes, scored by 2 blinded LLM judges over 3 runs (330 judgments), with clinician adjudication of every flagged claim. The system stayed within its locked corpus, declined all out-of-scope queries, and achieved 98.4% guideline-routing recall. The Context Gate showed 91.9% specificity and 78.6% sensitivity for underspecified queries, and all 259 cited recommendations were verifiable within the locked corpus. Automated judges flagged an unsupported claim in 18.2% of items under a sensitive screening definition; on adjudication by 2 vascular surgeons, 7.3% of items contained a clinically consequential error, none graded capable of causing harm. Clinical acceptability of complete answers was not scored and is reserved for prospective expert evaluation. These results support the feasibility of a multi-guideline context-aware clinical agent for vascular surgery; citation traceability and locked-corpus provenance facilitate future auditability.

abstract: Radiologists interpret computed tomography (CT) scans by jointly determining what a finding represents and where it lies in three-dimensional (3D) anatomy. However, CT models have treated CT interpretation and 3D segmentation as separate tasks, leaving textual findings spatially unverifiable and overlooking potential synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception. Here we present HoloCT, a generalist 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation by jointly modelling whole-volume context and fine-grained anatomical detail, providing 3D masks as evidence. We curated HoloDATA, comprising 195,921 CT scans from 73 public datasets and six clinical cohorts, with 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT-mask pairs. Across 346 tasks spanning segmentation, lesion screening, visual question answering, and report generation on 61 internal and 12 external datasets, HoloCT outperformed specialist and foundation models. In multicentre validation across 11,455 clinical CT scans from five hospitals, HoloCT outperformed competing models in lesion segmentation and report generation by 18.2 and 15.3 points. It also achieved 85.1% mean accuracy in screening thyroid tumours and colon lesions, exceeding all four participating radiologists in a retrospective reader study. Further analyses revealed bidirectional semantic-spatial synergy: language-guided segmentation delineated unseen anatomical structures and lesions as well as diffuse free-text findings, outperforming the leading approach by 22.1 points, whereas prompting the model to generate corresponding 3D masks alongside its textual outputs significantly improved interpretation performance. HoloCT shows that clinical understanding and spatial perception can be learned together within a single foundation model and offers a path towards more accurate and reliable CT analysis.

abstract: Genomic foundation models are increasingly used to propose DNA sequences and edits. But successful design requires capabilities that current benchmarks do not measure. Here we introduce BEND 2.0 (BENchmark for DNA language models), which tests how well models predict the effects of DNA changes and whether these predictions can guide sequence design. Across eight tasks built on five experimental datasets, we find that model choice and how representations are accessed both affect performance. Linear readouts fitted to frozen representations can match or exceed models' native outputs, and functional post-training substantially improves the models' capabilities. Linear readouts transfer well across experimental assays and genes, suggesting that models capture functional patterns beyond the data used to fit individual predictors. At the same time, strong prediction of average effects can conceal weaker prediction of context-specific effects, and accurate prediction of combined mutation effects does not imply accurate prediction of their interactions. In design tasks, model predictions can reduce the number of candidates needed to find a desired response, but still leave substantial room for better design choices, particularly for context-specific and multi-cell objectives. Our benchmark reveals that genomic models now display signs of general utility but have yet to saturate on performance in even simple tasks.

abstract: Protein-complex structure prediction with AlphaFold 3 depends on MSA content, depth, and cross-chain pairing. Current pipelines apply uniform recipes, typically maximizing depth and pairing by species, yet even whether cross-chain pairing helps AF3 remains contested. We show that the value of both depth and pairing is strongly target-dependent, so no single recipe is optimal across interfaces. We introduce an autonomous agent that treats a frozen AF3 as a black-box experimental instrument. For each target, the agent formulates biological hypotheses, analyzes and reorganizes the MSA, and iteratively refines sequence selection and pairing using predictor label-free signals alone. On 1{,}015 protein--protein interfaces from three benchmarks released after AF3's training cutoff, the agent improves overall interface DockQ over AF3's default pipeline and fixed MSA recipes on every benchmark, while using on average 60\% fewer MSA sequences than the default. Gains are largest for inter-species heteromers, where species-based pairing is unreliable: mean DockQ increases from 0.465 to 0.612 on FoldBench and from 0.482 to 0.562 on HD439. The improvements arise from both sequence construction and pairing policy, including deliberate non-pairing.These results recast MSA design as a target-specific problem and show that an autonomous agent can adapt it at test time through biological reasoning and self-directed, confidence-guided experimentation.

abstract: [Journal of neurosurgical sciences] To evaluate the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) tools on workflow efficiency, treatment times, and clinical outcomes in patients with large vessel occlusion (LVO) stroke. We included observational studies that assessed the implementation of AI-based tools in the management of patients with suspected or confirmed LVO stroke. Eligible studies reported workflow, treatment, safety, or functional outcomes. Data were extracted on thrombolysis rates, CTA-to-arterial puncture time, door-to-puncture time, endovascular treatment (EVT) access, reperfusion success, symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage (sICH), mortality, and functional independence (mRS 0-2) at 90 days. Random-effects models were applied to calculate pooled mean differences (MD) or risk ratios (RR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Thirteen studies were included. AI implementation significantly reduced workflow delays: CTA-to-puncture time decreased by -40.20 minutes (95% CI -66.41 to -13.99; P<0.01) and door-to-puncture time by -23.17 minutes (95% CI -38.71 to -7.63; P<0.01). Thrombolysis administration showed no difference (RR 0.79; 95% CI 0.57-1.09; P=0.15). Similarly, no significant effects were observed for EVT access (RR 0.97; 95% CI 0.66-1.44; P=0.89), reperfusion success (RR 1.06; 95% CI 1.00-1.12; P=0.06), sICH (RR 0.63; 95% CI 0.30-1.35; P=0.23), or mortality (RR 0.72; 95% CI 0.38-1.37; P=0.32). However, AI-based workflows significantly improved functional independence at 90 days (RR 1.55; 95% CI 1.12-2.15; P=0.008). AI tools significantly improve treatment times and functional independence in acute LVO stroke without increasing adverse events.

abstract: [BMC medical imaging] Virtual contrast-enhanced (vCE) breast MRI is a deep learning approach for generating contrast-like images from non-contrast acquisitions. As diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) has emerged as a major contributor to enhancement synthesis, understanding the influence of DWI-related image artifacts is important for the robustness and potential clinical implementation of AI-based contrast-free imaging approaches. We evaluated the robustness of a pix2pix-based vCE synthesis model to artifact-contaminated DWI during training and inference. This IRB-approved, retrospective study included 1,974 multiparametric breast MRI examinations (mean age: 49 years) acquired with two clinical routine 3T MRI scanners (2017-2022). High b-value (b = 1500 s/mm2) DWI images were automatically classified for high-intensity (HI) and low-intensity (LI) artifacts using a pretrained neural network. A pix2pix 2D-GAN was trained either after excluding artifact-affected slices (vCE-clean) or using all available slices (vCE-all). Performance was evaluated using image similarity metrics, lesion-based analysis, reader assessment, and correlation of artifact scores with reconstruction errors. Excluding artifact-affected slices during training resulted in a small but statistically significant increase in whole-image structural similarity index (SSIM) with small effect size (vCE-all 0.843 ± 0.034; vCE-clean 0.849 ± 0.031, p < 0.001, dav = 0.20). However, lesion-based metrics and qualitative ratings of lesion enhancement and image quality were comparable between models. During Inference, strong LI DWI artifacts were associated with higher lesion-based errors. Controlling for artifacts on diffusion weighted imaging (DWI) during vCE training only minorly influenced technical metrics but not perceived image quality/lesion enhancement. In contrast, severe signal-loss artifacts during inference impaired local performance, highlighting the importance of image quality control during potential deployment.

abstract: Deep models for radiological diagnosis are typically trained to predict disease labels directly from images, which limits them to diseases seen during training and makes their decisions hard to interpret in radiologists' terms. Radiology, however, proceeds from visual findings to disease through published guidelines that make this decision rule explicit, interpretable, and reproducible. We introduce diagnosis by composition (DbC), a representation learning framework that encodes this findings-first logic. DbC learns a vocabulary of radiological findings by aligning image features with the text embeddings of the findings, each finding represented as a dense map over the scan. A disease is defined by a set of required findings derived from its guidelines, and its diagnosis map is a fixed, parameter-free composition of the corresponding finding maps. Because the finding-to-disease mapping is derived from guidelines rather than learned, DbC is interpretable and auditable by design, can extend to new diseases by specifying their findings without retraining, and can diagnose unseen diseases by composing their findings. On multi-phase liver CT, DbC detects and localizes unseen diseases, rare diseases from a different institution, and an external cohort significantly better than all comparators, including models that align images with disease names. DbC also improves detection and localization in the fully supervised setting and remains superior across training-set sizes. Although demonstrated on liver CT, DbC applies wherever radiological guidelines define diseases through findings.
zh_abstract: 用于放射学诊断的深度模型通常被训练为直接从图像预测疾病标签，这使其局限于训练期间见过的疾病，也使其决策难以用放射科医生的语言加以解释。然而，放射学是依据已发表的指南，从影像学征象推进到疾病诊断的，而这些指南使决策规则明确、可解释且可重复。我们提出“组合式诊断”（diagnosis by composition，DbC），这是一种编码此种“先征象、后疾病”逻辑的表征学习框架。DbC 通过将图像特征与征象的文本嵌入对齐来学习一套放射学征象词汇表，每个征象表示为覆盖整个扫描的稠密图。疾病由源自其指南的一组必需征象定义，其诊断图则是相应征象图的一种固定的、无参数的组合。由于征象到疾病的映射来自指南而非学习得到，DbC 在设计上即具有可解释性和可审计性，只需指定新疾病的征象而无需重新训练即可扩展到新疾病，并可通过组合其征象来诊断未见过的疾病。在多期相肝脏 CT 上，DbC 对未见疾病、来自另一机构的罕见疾病以及外部队列的检测和定位均显著优于所有对照方法，包括将图像与疾病名称对齐的模型。在完全监督的设置下，DbC 同样改善了检测和定位，并在不同训练集规模下始终保持优势。尽管本研究以肝脏 CT 为例进行了验证，但凡是放射学指南通过征象来定义疾病的场景，DbC 均可适用。

title: OpenBrain: An Auditable Generated-Label Release for Whole-Brain MRI Parcellation
zh_title: OpenBrain：可审计的全脑MRI分割生成标签发布
summary: 预印本发布覆盖607个OpenNeuro数据集、35,838例T1w的置信度感知脑分割标签，附来源溯源、QC指标与置信分层。
key_points: 含35,838例，来自607个数据源
每例含主/委员会分割与QC-7风险评分
用户可按置信度筛选或重设阈值
reason: 大规模公开数据集发布，但为预印本且为生成标签
abstract: Automatic tools can now generate whole-brain MRI parcellations at cohort scale, but generated-label releases often provide little evidence about which cases are reliable enough to reuse. We introduce OpenBrain, a confidence-aware release of 35,838 provenance-verified OpenNeuro T1w cases from 607 source datasets. OpenBrain is organized as an auditable case-record release rather than a directory of standalone segmentation files: each record links a primary parcellation, two committee parcellations, source/license provenance, raw QC-7 measurements, percentile risks, a combined risk score R, and a confidence tier. QC-7 is a reference-free reliability panel over label geometry, image-label consistency, and committee disagreement, so users can filter, weight, audit, or re-threshold generated labels without rerunning inference. We evaluate this released evidence under a frozen protocol. Across external cohorts, lower QC-7 risk corresponds to higher generated-label quality; in fixed-budget training, lower-risk selections improve paired macro Dice over random selection by +3.2 to +3.7 percentage points. OpenBrain also exposes raw axes, committee outputs, provenance, and datasheet documentation, so confidence claims remain inspectable after download. It does not turn generated labels into manual annotations or clinical-grade segmentations. Its contribution is a large open generated-parcellation substrate, a reusable case-level risk-evidence layer, and an external validation protocol for release-time QC. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lanqz7766/OpenBrain. Code: https://github.com/lanqz7766/openbrain.
zh_abstract: 自动化工具如今可以在队列规模上生成全脑MRI分区（parcellation），但已发布的生成标签往往几乎没有提供证据来说明哪些病例足够可靠、可供复用。我们提出OpenBrain，这是一个具有置信度感知的发布版本，包含来自607个源数据集、经来源验证的35,838例OpenNeuro T1w病例。OpenBrain被组织为可审计的病例记录发布，而非独立分割文件的目录：每条记录关联一个主分区结果、两个委员会（committee）分区结果、数据来源/许可证溯源信息、原始QC-7测量值、百分位风险、综合风险评分R以及置信度等级。QC-7是一套无需参考标准的可靠性评估面板，涵盖标签几何、图像-标签一致性和委员会分歧，因此用户无需重新运行推理，即可对生成标签进行筛选、加权、审计或重新设定阈值。我们在冻结的方案下评估了这些已发布的证据。在多个外部队列中，较低的QC-7风险对应较高的生成标签质量；在固定预算的训练中，与随机选择相比，选择低风险病例可使配对宏平均Dice提高+3.2至+3.7个百分点。OpenBrain还公开了原始评估维度、委员会输出、数据来源和数据集说明文档，因此下载后置信度相关结论仍可被检验。它并不能将生成标签转变为人工标注或临床级分割。其贡献在于：一个大规模开放的生成式分区基础资源、一个可复用的病例级风险证据层，以及一套用于发布时质量控制的外部验证方案。数据集：https://huggingface.co/datasets/lanqz7766/OpenBrain。代码：https://github.com/lanqz7766/openbrain。

title: Multimodal Fusion Methods for Whole-Slide Images and Clinical Data in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
zh_title: 炎症性肠病全切片图像与临床数据的多模态融合方法比较
summary: 在前瞻性IBD队列中，基于冻结病理基础模型嵌入，在统一框架下比较15种融合方法预测STRIDE-II缓解结局。
key_points: 注意力聚合器加冻结基础模型的切片嵌入
最佳融合macro-F1为0.57-0.75
六个场景中四个优于单模态，最优方法随结局而异
reason: 前瞻队列、系统对比多种融合，预印本，证据有限；病理多模态加分
abstract: Multimodal AI fusion of histology and clinical data is an active research area in computational pathology, but fusion methods are rarely compared under identical conditions and across different clinical endpoints. We present a modular framework in which slide-level embeddings, obtained by training an attention-based aggregator over patch embeddings from a frozen foundation model, and per-visit clinical embeddings are fed into 15 interchangeable fusion methods with a shared output dimension and prediction head (except decision-level methods). Using a prospective cohort of newly diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease patients, we predicted STRIDE-II-aligned remission outcomes from baseline or follow-up visits. The best fusion method reached macro-F1 of 0.57-0.75, outperforming both single-modality models in four of six scenarios, and differed by outcome and input. Image reliance, the drop in balanced accuracy when the slide embedding is removed, tended to follow the remission type - highest for histological and lowest for endoscopic remission; methods with similar accuracy relied on the slide to very different degrees.

title: Does Your Trial Simulator Know What the Drug Does? An Intervention-Blind Test of Interventional Validity on 7,207 Registered Trials
zh_title: 试验模拟器是否知道药物作用？7,207项注册试验的干预盲测
summary: 基于ClinicalTrials.gov的9,996个试验内对比，通过干预盲参照衡量患者世界模型作为试验模拟器的干预有效性。
key_points: 从30,119项II/III期试验构建7,207项试验的对比
以隐藏干预信息的同模型为参照度量干预技能
时间划分测试含655项试验的878个对比
reason: 世界模型与试验模拟的评测方法新颖，规模大，预印本
abstract: Patient world models are increasingly proposed as simulators of clinical trials, and recent surveys rank their capabilities on a ladder from temporal prediction to counterfactual rollouts. Position on that ladder is currently assigned by reading papers rather than by measurement. We turn the counterfactual rung into a measured quantity. From 30,119 completed phase 2/3 trials with results posted to ClinicalTrials.gov we construct 9,996 audited within-trial contrasts from 7,207 trials, and we score a simulator on how much of its accuracy depends on knowing which intervention was tested. The instrument is an intervention-blind reference: the same model, trained on the same trials, with every intervention-identifying field withheld. Interventional skill is the error the full model removes relative to that reference. On a temporal split (878 test contrasts from 655 trials) a registry-trained gradient-boosting simulator removes a fifth of the error of a trivial baseline, but its interventional skill is -0.12 (95% CI -0.21 to -0.05): withholding the intervention makes it better, and no alternative featurisation, stratum, temporal cut or same-molecule retrieval yields an interval above zero. A frontier language model reading only the registered protocol has interventional skill 0.20 [0.08, 0.31]; smaller and open-weight models sit at the limit of detection. Perturbation tests show the large model uses the intervention as such: swapping the arms reverses the sign of its prediction in 86% of contrasts. The blind reference is itself not drug-blind (a language model recovers the withheld drug class 45% of the time from the blind prompt), so interventional skill is a conservative lower bound. A reliability layer shows that ranking by predicted error lowers it but that calibrated error control does not transfer under temporal shift. Benchmark, code, prompts and per-call model outputs are released.
zh_abstract: 患者世界模型正越来越多地被提出作为临床试验的模拟器，近期综述按从时间预测到反事实推演的阶梯对其能力进行排序。目前，在该阶梯上的位置是通过阅读论文而非测量来确定的。我们将反事实这一阶梯层级转化为可测量的量。我们从 ClinicalTrials.gov 上已公布结果的 30,119 项已完成的 2/3 期试验中，构建了来自 7,207 项试验的 9,996 个经审核的试验内对比，并依据模拟器的准确性在多大程度上依赖于知晓所检验的干预措施来对其评分。所用工具是一个干预盲化的参照：同一模型，在相同试验上训练，但隐去所有可识别干预的字段。干预技能（interventional skill）定义为完整模型相对于该参照所消除的误差。在时间划分的测试中（来自 655 项试验的 878 个测试对比），基于注册信息训练的梯度提升模拟器消除了简单基线五分之一的误差，但其干预技能为 -0.12（95% CI -0.21 至 -0.05）：隐去干预信息反而使其表现更好，且没有任何替代特征化方式、分层、时间切分或同分子检索能得到高于零的区间。仅阅读注册方案的前沿语言模型的干预技能为 0.20 [0.08, 0.31]；较小的及开放权重模型处于检测极限。扰动测试表明大模型确实将干预作为干预本身加以利用：交换各组会使其 86% 对比中的预测符号反转。盲化参照本身并非对药物完全盲化（语言模型可从盲化提示中还原被隐去的药物类别，比例为 45%），因此干预技能是一个保守的下界。可靠性层分析显示，按预测误差排序可降低误差，但经校准的误差控制在时间偏移下无法迁移。基准、代码、提示词及逐次调用的模型输出均已公开。

title: Lesion Overlap Ranks PET Segmentation Models but Does Not Certify Patient-Level Tumor Burden
zh_title: 病灶重叠指标可排序PET分割模型，但不能保证患者级肿瘤负荷可靠
summary: 预印本基于1,014例autoPET研究发现，Dice可对模型整体排序，但在患者层面16.8%病例与MTV误差方向相反。
key_points: 五个FDG模型的Dice排序与MTV误差排序一致
489例阳性患者中82例（16.8%）出现相反情形
另在597例PSMA研究中检验结果
reason: 评估方法学洞察，样本较大并含PSMA验证，但为预印本
abstract: Metabolic tumor volume (MTV) summarizes whole-body PET disease burden for prognostic stratification and treatment assessment. Automated MTV is useful only if its estimate is reliable for the individual patient, yet segmentation models are usually evaluated with overlap metrics such as Dice rather than burden error. We examined whether overlap metrics identify unreliable MTV estimates using 1,014 autoPET FDG PET/CT studies. We evaluated LesionTracer predictions held out from fine-tuning, compared five selected released models on 489 tumor-positive patients, and examined the findings in 597 PSMA studies. Across the five FDG models, ranking by higher mean Dice gave the same order as ranking by lower mean relative MTV error ($ρ=-1.00$, exact $p=0.017$). At the patient level, however, out-of-fold Dice tracked relative MTV error strongly ($ρ=-0.75$), yet 82 of 489 patients (16.8\%) fell on opposite sides of the Dice 0.80 and MTV-error 25\% thresholds. Within the training-exposed released models, correlations ranged from $-0.47$ to $-0.74$ over narrower, high-Dice ranges. Out of fold, opposing false-positive and false-negative volumes cancelled about one third of spatial error in net MTV. In 236 of 489 patients, each of the five models missed at least one lesion, though not necessarily the same lesion. Thus, agreement in average model rankings did not establish the reliability of individual MTV estimates or reveal shared lesion misses. PET segmentation benchmarks should report patient-level MTV error and missed-lesion counts alongside Dice and other overlap metrics.
zh_abstract: 代谢肿瘤体积（MTV）概括了全身PET疾病负荷，可用于预后分层和治疗评估。只有当自动化MTV对个体患者的估计可靠时，它才有用，但分割模型通常用Dice等重叠度指标评估，而不是用负荷误差。我们使用1,014例autoPET FDG PET/CT检查，考察重叠度指标能否识别不可靠的MTV估计。我们评估了未参与微调的LesionTracer预测结果，在489例肿瘤阳性患者中比较了五个选定的已发布模型，并在597例PSMA检查中验证了这些发现。在五个FDG模型中，按平均Dice从高到低排序，与按平均相对MTV误差从低到高排序的顺序一致（$ρ=-1.00$，精确 $p=0.017$）。然而在患者层面，折外（out-of-fold）Dice与相对MTV误差密切相关（$ρ=-0.75$），但489例患者中仍有82例（16.8%）落在Dice 0.80阈值与MTV误差25%阈值的相反两侧。在曾接触训练数据的已发布模型中，在较窄的高Dice范围内，相关系数为$-0.47$至$-0.74$。在折外预测中，方向相反的假阳性和假阴性体积抵消了净MTV中约三分之一的空间误差。在489例患者中的236例，五个模型各自至少漏掉一个病灶，但漏掉的不一定是同一病灶。因此，平均模型排名的一致并不能证明个体MTV估计的可靠性，也不能揭示共同漏检的病灶。PET分割基准除Dice及其他重叠度指标外，还应报告患者层面的MTV误差和漏检病灶数。

title: EEGDash Corpus: A Training-Ready Public Corpus for EEG Foundation Models
zh_title: EEGDash Corpus：面向EEG基础模型的可训练公开语料
summary: 发布包含77个公开EEG数据集、14,075小时、7,272名受试者的训练就绪语料，附每个文件的SHA-256，托管于Hugging Face。
key_points: 整合REVE预训练所用数据集中可再分发的部分
77个数据集，约14,075小时
以受限访问方式公开发布
reason: 大规模公开EEG数据资源，利于基础模型，但为预印本
abstract: Foundation models for electroencephalography (EEG) are pretrained on tens of thousands of hours of recordings, and their accuracy grows with that amount. Such data is hard to assemble. The largest sources are clinical archives that cannot be redistributed, and the public sources are spread over several archives, file formats, and licences. We release eegdash-corpus-v0, a training-ready corpus of 77 public EEG datasets, as the gated Hugging Face dataset EEGDash/eegdash-corpus-v0 with the SHA-256 of every file. REVE, the largest published EEG foundation model, names 89 datasets as its pretraining corpus. Twelve cannot be redistributed: four clinical archives that hold 82% of its hours, and eight under no-derivatives licences. The corpus holds the 76 others that REVE's sampling rate allows and one more from REVE's release card: 77 datasets, 14,075 hours from 7,272 subjects, 5.0 million 10-second samples and 6.21 billion tokens per epoch. Every dataset is fetched through EEGDash, converted once with REVE's recipe, and stored in its own buckets of a chunked Zarr store with its licence recorded beside it, so a model can train on the whole store or on any subset of datasets. To test that the store pretrains a model, we retrain REVE-Base from scratch twice with the authors' code, changed only in how it reads data, and score it on seven public OpenEEGBench tasks. It reaches 0.331 under linear probing and 0.273 after fine-tuning, against 0.333 and 0.325 for the released model and 0.200 and 0.205 for an untrained encoder. The converter, the conversion reports, and the loader changes are released with the corpus.
zh_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型在数万小时的记录上进行预训练，其准确性随数据量增长。此类数据难以汇集。最大的数据来源是无法再分发的临床档案，而公开来源分散于多个档案库、文件格式和许可协议之中。我们发布了eegdash-corpus-v0，这是一个可直接用于训练的语料库，包含77个公开EEG数据集，以受限访问的Hugging Face数据集EEGDash/eegdash-corpus-v0形式提供，并附有每个文件的SHA-256。已发表的最大EEG基础模型REVE列出了89个数据集作为其预训练语料。其中12个无法再分发：四个临床档案（占其总时长的82%），以及八个采用禁止衍生作品许可的数据集。本语料库包含REVE采样率所允许的其余76个数据集，外加REVE发布说明卡中的另一个数据集：共77个数据集，来自7,272名受试者，总计14,075小时，每个epoch有500万个10秒样本和62.1亿个token。每个数据集均通过EEGDash获取，按REVE的流程一次性转换，并存储在分块Zarr存储中各自独立的桶内，其许可协议记录在旁，因此模型可以在整个存储上训练，也可以只在任意数据集子集上训练。为验证该存储可用于预训练模型，我们使用作者的代码从头两次重新训练REVE-Base，仅改变其读取数据的方式，并在七个公开的OpenEEGBench任务上评分。其线性探测得分为0.331，微调后为0.273；相比之下，已发布模型分别为0.333和0.325，未训练的编码器分别为0.200和0.205。转换器、转换报告和加载器的修改均随语料库一同发布。

title: Can saliency maps flag chest radiograph classifier errors at a new hospital? An external validation study
zh_title: 显著性图能否发现新医院胸片分类器的错误？外部验证
summary: 在NIH ChestX-ray14训练CNN与ViT，并在美国和越南两家外部医院评估，发现显著性图难以在置信度之外额外识别错误。

Grad-CAM定位命中率最高0.575，低于放射科医师0.888

abstract: Saliency maps are offered as a safeguard for medical image classifiers, but whether they reveal individual errors at a new hospital remains largely untested. We trained a convolutional network and a vision transformer on NIH ChestX-ray14 and evaluated 303,768 decisions per model at the training hospital and at two external sites, in the USA and Vietnam, with radiologist-consensus labels. We scored each explanation by its anatomical enrichment, the area-normalized concentration of attribution in a segmented thoracic region, and tested whether it detects errors beyond the model's confidence. Grad-CAM localized findings less often than radiologists (hit rate at most 0.575 versus 0.888). Adding enrichment to a confidence-based error detector calibrated at the training hospital never raised its area under the curve by more than 0.011, and for the convolutional network the relation between enrichment and correctness reversed between hospitals, degrading the transferred detector. Model confidence, not saliency, should anchor deployment monitoring.
zh_abstract: 显著性图被用作医学图像分类器的一种保障手段，但它能否在新医院揭示个体错误，在很大程度上尚未得到检验。我们在 NIH ChestX-ray14 上训练了一个卷积网络和一个视觉 Transformer，并在训练医院以及美国和越南的两个外部站点上，利用放射科医生共识标签，对每个模型评估了 303,768 个决策。我们以解剖富集度（即归因在分割出的胸部区域内按面积归一化的集中程度）为每个解释打分，并检验其能否在模型置信度之外检测出错误。Grad-CAM 对病变的定位频率低于放射科医生（命中率最高为 0.575，而放射科医生为 0.888）。在训练医院校准的基于置信度的错误检测器中加入富集度后，其曲线下面积的提升从未超过 0.011；对于卷积网络，富集度与正确性之间的关系在不同医院之间发生反转，使迁移后的检测器性能下降。部署监测应以模型置信度而非显著性为依据。

title: All-Atom Structure Tokenizer: AtomLM-9b for Biomolecular Structure Prediction
zh_title: 全原子结构分词器与AtomLM-9b结构预测
summary: 提出全原子结构分词器，并基于Qwen3.5-9B训练AtomLM-9b，称结构预测性能可与AlphaFold 3相当。

abstract: We develop an All-atom Structure Tokenizer that compresses biomolecular geometry into discrete structural tokens and achieves high-accuracy all-atom reconstruction. A hierarchical geometric encoder and finite scalar quantization map chemical units to a shared vocabulary of 8,192 tokens, while a joint coordinate de-tokenizer reconstructs backbone, side-chain, nucleic-acid, and ligand heavy atoms. The tokenizer achieves all-atom lDDT scores of 0.832 and 0.835 on CASP14 and CASP15, respectively. Building on this tokenizer, we train AtomLM-9b, an autoregressive language model based on Qwen3.5-9B that predicts structural tokens from molecular identities and connectivity and decodes them into complete atomic structures. We demonstrate, for the first time, protein structure prediction performance comparable to AlphaFold 3 with an all-atom-tokenizer-based structural language model: on the FoldBench protein-protein task, AtomLM-9b achieves a success rate of 75.01%, compared with the published AlphaFold 3 result of 72.93%. These results establish discrete all-atom tokenization as an effective interface between high-fidelity atomic reconstruction and language-model-based structure prediction.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了一种全原子结构分词器（All-atom Structure Tokenizer），可将生物分子几何结构压缩为离散的结构标记（token），并实现高精度的全原子重建。分层几何编码器与有限标量量化（finite scalar quantization）将化学单元映射到包含 8,192 个标记的共享词表，同时联合坐标解标记器可重建主链、侧链、核酸和配体的重原子。该分词器在 CASP14 和 CASP15 上的全原子 lDDT 分数分别为 0.832 和 0.835。在此分词器的基础上，我们训练了 AtomLM-9b，这是一个基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的自回归语言模型，可根据分子身份和连接关系预测结构标记，并将其解码为完整的原子结构。我们首次证明，基于全原子分词器的结构语言模型可达到与 AlphaFold 3 相当的蛋白质结构预测性能：在 FoldBench 蛋白质-蛋白质任务上，AtomLM-9b 的成功率为 75.01%，而已发表的 AlphaFold 3 结果为 72.93%。这些结果表明，离散全原子分词是连接高保真原子重建与基于语言模型的结构预测的有效接口。

title: Deep-Reorder: Refined Motion Correction for 3D Brain MRI via Iterative Data Regrouping.
zh_title: Deep-Reorder：迭代数据重组的3D脑MRI运动校正
summary: 提出利用深度学习重建时间有序k空间片段并迭代重组分组的方法，提高3D脑MRI扫描内运动估计的时间分辨率与校正效果。
key_points: 从非相干采样出发，深度学习重建k空间片段图像
通过配准估计运动，并任意重组shots迭代校正
重组可提高运动估计的有效时间分辨率

abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] Accurate and temporally high-resolution estimation of subject motion is paramount for effective motion-correction in MRI. This work proposes a novel approach for estimating subject motion within a 3D MRI scan with high temporal resolution. Starting from an incoherent sampling scheme, images are reconstructed from temporally ordered k-space fractions via deep learning, enabling motion estimation via registration between each image. Assuming the bulk of the motion is removed using these initial estimates, the remaining misalignment between k-space fractions is expected to be minimally correlated in time. Based on this insight, an iterative strategy is proposed in which shots are arbitrarily regrouped into new k-space fractions, regardless of their original temporal ordering, for subsequent motion estimation and correction. This effectively increases the temporal resolution of the approach, enabling individual correction of all shots. When applied to 3D T1w TFE MRI of the brain, the proposed approach "Deep-Reorder" estimated a unique motion state for all shots, producing significantly better estimations of retrospective motion compared to estimation without iterative data regrouping. On prospectively motion-corrupted scans with intentional head movement by volunteers, the proposed approach consistently improved image quality, producing less noisy images with reduced motion artifacts. In conclusion, the proposed approach, which is free of external tracking devices or navigators, effectively estimated 3D motion and corrected motion artifacts with increased temporal resolution.
zh_abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] 准确且具有高时间分辨率的受试者运动估计对于 MRI 中有效的运动校正至关重要。本研究提出了一种新方法，可在 3D MRI 扫描中以高时间分辨率估计受试者运动。该方法从非相干采样方案出发，通过深度学习由按时间顺序排列的 k 空间片段重建图像，并通过各图像之间的配准来估计运动。假设利用这些初始估计已消除了大部分运动，则 k 空间片段之间残余的错位在时间上应具有极小的相关性。基于这一认识，提出了一种迭代策略：将各次激发（shot）不考虑其原始时间顺序而任意重新分组为新的 k 空间片段，用于后续的运动估计与校正。这有效提高了该方法的时间分辨率，使得能够对所有激发逐一进行校正。在应用于脑部 3D T1w TFE MRI 时，所提出的方法“Deep-Reorder”为所有激发估计出各自独立的运动状态，与不进行迭代数据重新分组的估计相比，对回顾性运动的估计显著更好。在志愿者故意移动头部的前瞻性运动污染扫描上，该方法持续改善了图像质量，得到噪声更少、运动伪影减轻的图像。总之，所提出的方法无需外部跟踪设备或导航回波，即可有效估计 3D 运动并校正运动伪影，同时提高了时间分辨率。

title: Adversarial robustness of deep learning-based thyroid nodule segmentation in ultrasound.
zh_title: 超声甲状腺结节分割的对抗鲁棒性

key_points: 提出SSAA与FDUA两种黑盒攻击
评估随机预处理、去噪和集成推理三类防御
聚焦超声分割模型的安全性

abstract: [PLOS digital health] Deep learning-based segmentation models are increasingly integrated into clinical imaging workflows, yet their robustness to adversarial perturbations remains incompletely characterized, particularly for ultrasound images. We evaluated adversarial attacks and inference-time defenses for thyroid nodule segmentation in B-mode ultrasound. Two black-box adversarial attacks were developed: (1) Structured Speckle Amplification Attack (SSAA), which injects boundary-targeted noise, and (2) Frequency-Domain Ultrasound Attack (FDUA), which applies bandpass-filtered phase perturbations in the Fourier domain. Three inference-time mitigations were evaluated on adversarial images: randomized preprocessing with test-time augmentation, deterministic input denoising, and stochastic ensemble inference with consistency-aware aggregation. Experiments were conducted on a U-Net segmentation model trained on cine-clips from a database of 192 thyroid nodules. The baseline model achieved a mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) of 0.76 (SD 0.20) on unperturbed images. SSAA reduced DSC by 0.29 (SD 0.20), from 0.76 to 0.47, while maintaining high visual similarity (SSIM = 0.94). FDUA resulted in a smaller DSC reduction of 0.11 (SD 0.09), from 0.76 to 0.65, with lower visual fidelity (SSIM = 0.82). Against SSAA, all three defenses significantly improved DSC after correction, with deterministic denoising showing the largest recovery (+0.10, p < 0.001), followed by randomized preprocessing (+0.09, p < 0.001), and stochastic ensemble inference (+0.08, p = 0.002). No defense achieved statistically significant improvement against FDUA, although recall consistently improved at the cost of reduced precision. The tested inference-time defenses therefore partially mitigated spatial-domain perturbations, whereas statistically significant DSC recovery was not demonstrated against frequency-domain perturbations, highlighting attack-specific challenges in adversarial robustness evaluation.
zh_abstract: [PLOS digital health] 基于深度学习的分割模型正越来越多地整合进临床影像工作流程，但其对对抗性扰动的鲁棒性仍未得到充分刻画，超声图像尤其如此。我们评估了B型超声甲状腺结节分割中的对抗攻击和推理时防御。我们开发了两种黑盒对抗攻击：（1）结构化散斑放大攻击（Structured Speckle Amplification Attack，SSAA），其注入针对边界的噪声；（2）频域超声攻击（Frequency-Domain Ultrasound Attack，FDUA），其在傅里叶域施加带通滤波的相位扰动。我们在对抗图像上评估了三种推理时缓解措施：随机预处理结合测试时增强、确定性输入去噪，以及带一致性感知聚合的随机集成推理。实验在一个U-Net分割模型上进行，该模型基于192个甲状腺结节数据库中的电影片段（cine-clips）训练。基线模型在未扰动图像上的平均Dice相似系数（DSC）为0.76（SD 0.20）。SSAA使DSC下降0.29（SD 0.20），由0.76降至0.47，同时保持较高的视觉相似度（SSIM = 0.94）。FDUA导致的DSC下降较小，为0.11（SD 0.09），由0.76降至0.65，视觉保真度较低（SSIM = 0.82）。针对SSAA，三种防御在校正后均显著提高了DSC，其中确定性去噪恢复最大（+0.10，p < 0.001），其次是随机预处理（+0.09，p < 0.001）和随机集成推理（+0.08，p = 0.002）。针对FDUA，没有任何防御取得统计学显著的改善，尽管召回率持续提高，但以精确率降低为代价。因此，所测试的推理时防御能部分缓解空间域扰动，而针对频域扰动未显示出具有统计学意义的DSC恢复，这凸显了对抗鲁棒性评估中存在针对特定攻击的挑战。

title: Sycophancy and Extended Engagement with Publicly Accessible Generative AI: Aligning Deployment with Mental Health Needs.

abstract: [Current psychiatry reports] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming a routine source of health information, emotional support, and companionship. As its use expands, the key public health question is not only whether these tools can support care, but whether their deployment is aligned with the mental health needs of the community. In this commentary, we argue that general-purpose AI systems pose distinct psychosocial risks, especially for young people and those experiencing loneliness or psychological distress. Emerging evidence suggests that sustained chatbot use may be associated with loneliness, reduced socialisation, emotional dependence, and problematic use, while sycophantic model behaviour may undermine users' capacity for self-correction and sustain a feedback loop of engagement. Current AI policy frameworks address governance and safety, but do not yet provide a coordinated response to these mental health risks. Realising the benefits of AI without preventable community-level harm will require independent longitudinal research, psychosocial safety benchmarking, transparent post-deployment monitoring, and safety by design principles.

abstract: [JMIR formative research] AI technologies have considerable potential to support mental health practitioners in identifying depression symptoms. However, existing tools are often developed with limited practitioner involvement and evaluated primarily on technical performance, leaving questions of clinical relevance, ethical design, and practitioner trust insufficiently addressed. This study aimed to examine how iterative co-design with mental health practitioners can inform the development of an AI-based model for identifying depression symptoms, focusing on how practitioner input shaped its clinical relevance and ethical foundations across 2 design cycles. We conducted a 2-stage qualitative co-design study. In stage 1, we developed DepressionSymp 1.0, a fine-tuned GPT-3.5 model trained on the CounselChat dataset, identifying 5 symptom categories based on the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition (DSM-5) criteria and the Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count (LIWC-22) psycholinguistic framework, reviewed and discussed by 6 mental health practitioners during online co-design workshops. In stage 2, this feedback informed DepressionSymp 2.0, expanded to 10 symptom categories and reviewed by 8 further practitioners in a second round of workshops. Practitioners valued the structured symptom outputs for reducing cognitive workload and supporting intervention planning. In stage 1, indirect indicators such as social withdrawal, financial difficulties, and major life changes were often classified as lifestyle factors rather than symptoms; this informed the expansion to 10 categories in stage 2, described as clearer and more useful for preassessment. Risk categorization was identified as the most ethically sensitive aspect across both stages, alongside broader concerns including the lack of nonverbal information in text-based assessments, cultural and linguistic differences in symptom expression, and the potential for automation bias without sufficient human oversight. Iterative co-design with mental health practitioners is valuable for developing AI-based tools that are clinically relevant and ethically grounded, demonstrating how qualitative practitioner feedback can inform iterative model refinement and ethical design. zh_abstract: [JMIR formative research] 人工智能技术在支持心理健康从业者识别抑郁症状方面具有相当大的潜力。然而，现有工具的开发往往缺乏从业者的充分参与，且主要以技术性能为评价标准，使临床相关性、伦理设计和从业者信任等问题未得到充分解决。本研究旨在考察与心理健康从业者的迭代式共同设计（co-design）如何为基于人工智能的抑郁症状识别模型的开发提供信息，重点关注在两个设计周期中从业者的意见如何塑造其临床相关性和伦理基础。我们开展了一项两阶段定性共同设计研究。在第一阶段，我们开发了DepressionSymp 1.0，这是一个在CounselChat数据集上训练、经微调的GPT-3.5模型，依据《精神障碍诊断与统计手册》第五版（DSM-5）标准和语言查询与字词计数（LIWC-22）心理语言学框架识别5类症状，并由6名心理健康从业者在线上共同设计工作坊中进行审阅和讨论。在第二阶段，这些反馈促成了DepressionSymp 2.0，其症状类别扩展至10类，并在第二轮工作坊中由另外8名从业者审阅。从业者认为结构化的症状输出可减轻认知负担并支持干预规划，对此予以肯定。在第一阶段，社交退缩、经济困难和重大生活变化等间接指标常被归类为生活方式因素而非症状；这促使第二阶段扩展为10个类别，被描述为对预评估更清晰、更有用。风险分类在两个阶段中均被认为是伦理上最敏感的方面，此外还有更广泛的担忧，包括基于文本的评估缺乏非言语信息、症状表达的文化和语言差异，以及在缺乏充分人工监督时可能出现自动化偏倚。与心理健康从业者进行迭代式共同设计，对于开发临床相关且具有伦理基础的人工智能工具具有价值，说明了从业者的定性反馈如何为模型的迭代改进和伦理设计提供信息。研究结果为大语言模型（LLM）功能、从业者在环（practitioner-in-the-loop）监督，以及涵盖临床标准、知情同意和数据治理的伦理考量提供了设计启示。未来的工作应优先考虑更大

title: MedPhysBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Medical Physics Calculations and Error Detection

abstract: Medical physicists turn a prescription into a delivered dose and check one another's calculations, because one error in a beam calibration or a monitor-unit (MU) calculation can affect every patient treated with it. MedPhysBench has ten seeded generators of calculation items in radiation therapy, diagnostic imaging, nuclear medicine and radiation protection, up to clinical tasks such as a TG-51 calibration worksheet. Reference answers come from code implementing the governing protocols, and a grader converts units and applies tolerance bands. From the same inputs, separate checking items test error detection, showing a colleague's worksheet or only the colleague's result, half correct and half with one planted error. On a held-out test split of 1,200 items (half for two models), 12 models scored 33.3 to 100.0% on calculation. Of the nine answers graded incorrect for the four best (99.3-100.0%), five contained model errors and four followed NCRP Report 151 on points our items misstate or leave open. Below them, most models did worst on level-3 clinical tasks, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 omitted the inverse-square correction in 19 of 20 isocentric MU items. Five models detected at least 96.7% of mostly large planted errors with at most 4% false alarms; for four of the other seven, checking only the result raised false alarms significantly. In an exploratory targeted test with 20 public cases of an omitted inverse-square correction, the three best models tested caught it in every worksheet, and three weaker models accepted 16 to 18 of 20 planted worksheets, one of them while applying the correction in most of its own calculations. Claude Opus 5.5 accepted 6 of 20 wrong results, although it applied the correction in all 20 of its own. We report the effect of two problems in our shielding items, found after the runs, and release the code, per-item outcomes and targeted-test responses.

title: Personas Are Not People: Identity as State, Not Attribute

summary: 预印本指出合成人群中以固定人设模拟个体的假设不成立，借助人格研究与身份经济学主张将身份视为随情境激活的状态。

reason: 智能体社会模拟方向，观点性预印本，档内上调
abstract: Synthetic populations, large sets of simulated people, are increasingly used in place of real people to pretest surveys, simulate users and communities, and evaluate AI systems. Each simulated person is defined by a persona, a written profile of fixed traits, demographics, and attitudes that a language model is instructed to act out. Every such system assumes that a person's identity is a stable attribute that behaves the same way in every situation the simulation presents. We show that this assumption is not a harmless simplification. Three decades of personality research find the opposite. How a given person behaves varies more across contexts than people vary from one another. Drawing on identity economics, which describes how different situations activate different identities and norms within the same person, we separate behavior into three parts, which are stable traits, the identity a context calls up, and the situation itself. We then prove, under two stated assumptions, that any simulation built on fixed personas, no matter how detailed the personas or how large the underlying model, cannot reproduce the part of a population's behavior that is specific to it and its circumstances. We propose a new evaluation criterion based on this result and a person-in-context design that can meet it in principle. We test one version on a naturalistic Reddit personality corpus and on a published clinical-trial recruitment survey of a community with documented distrust of medical institutions. The design does produce context-dependent behavior when tested directly, but in neither setting does it fully match the real population, and we show where it falls short. The consequence for practice is a risk that synthetic-population evaluations misrepresent the groups whose behavior is most shaped by context, a distortion that richer personas cannot correct.

title: From Natural Images to Medical Scans: Transferability of Diffusion Models for Medical Image Generation

summary: 系统评估自然图像预训练对医学扩散模型生成的作用，涵盖潜空间与像素空间、131M–952M 参数及两个放射学数据集。
key_points: 自然图像初始化使像素空间 gFID 相对改善21-34%
潜空间改善约14%
收益体现空间结构而非语义

abstract: Transfer learning from natural images is standard in supervised and increasingly adopted in self-supervised medical image analysis, but its role in generative modelling, and in particular diffusion denoisers, remains underexplored. Medical diffusion models typically train the denoiser from scratch, with no systematic evaluation of natural-image transfer. We analyse this across latent and pixel paradigms, model sizes (131M-952M) and two radiology datasets (RadImageNet, BraTS), and ask which aspects of transfer support generation. We find that: i) Natural-image initialisation consistently improves generation, by 21-34% relative gFID in pixel space against 14% in latent space, where the tokeniser supplies much of the prior. gFID gains mirror downstream pathology classification and radiomic-feature FD, both proxies for clinical fidelity. ii) Benefits reflect spatial structure, not semantics: semantic probing does not predict generation quality, whereas a spatial-structure metric adapted to internal denoiser representations tracks gFID at $|r|=0.85$, positioning spatial organisation as a channel through which pretraining manifests. iii) Mixed-domain denoiser training shows that natural and medical images share similar layer-wise representations up to the late blocks, and mixing natural images into medical training improves fidelity. iv) Transfer benefit is tied to natural image initialisation, outperforming in-domain medical pretraining and several reinitialisation schemes. Overall, natural image denoisers transfer positively to medical ones in our setup. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit
zh_abstract: 自然图像的迁移学习在有监督医学图像分析中已是标准做法，并日益被用于自监督医学图像分析，但其在生成建模中的作用，尤其是在扩散去噪器（diffusion denoiser）中的作用，仍未得到充分研究。医学扩散模型通常从头训练去噪器，尚无对自然图像迁移的系统评估。我们在潜空间（latent）和像素空间（pixel）两种范式、不同模型规模（131M–952M）以及两个放射学数据集（RadImageNet、BraTS）上对此进行了分析，并探讨迁移的哪些方面有助于生成。我们发现：i）自然图像初始化持续改善生成效果，在像素空间中 gFID 相对改善 21–34%，而在潜空间中为 14%，因为在潜空间中分词器（tokeniser）已提供了大部分先验。gFID 的提升与下游病理分类以及影像组学特征 FD 的改善相一致，二者均为临床保真度的代理指标。ii）这种益处反映的是空间结构而非语义：语义探测并不能预测生成质量，而一种适用于去噪器内部表征的空间结构度量与 gFID 的相关性为 $|r|=0.85$，表明空间组织是预训练得以体现的一条途径。iii）混合域去噪器训练表明，自然图像与医学图像在直至后期模块之前具有相似的逐层表征，并且在医学训练中混入自然图像可提高保真度。iv）迁移收益与自然图像初始化相关联，其表现优于领域内的医学预训练以及若干重新初始化方案。总体而言，在我们的设置中，自然图像去噪器可正向迁移至医学去噪器。代码见 https://github.com/CAIROLab-Bern/rad-dit

title: Weight-space programming for auditing clinical decision networks
zh_title: 权重空间编程：用前沿LLM审计临床决策网络
summary: 研究让前沿语言模型仅凭临床协议和小型网络权重，审计并修复放疗申请筛查网络中被植入的缺陷，并在约42万条请求上检验。
key_points: 网络参数量433至4,801，筛查头颈部放疗计划请求
通过训练数据植入混杂、3 Gy阈值偏移与隐藏触发
Claude Opus 5.5盲审，无工具与代码执行
reason: 新颖方法，但为小型网络的合成缺陷，预印本
abstract: Machine learning models in radiotherapy are commissioned by testing them on cases with known answers, which may not reveal a shortcut that the test cases share with the training data. Frontier language models have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of small neural networks, an ability called weight-space programming. The purpose of this study was to determine whether such a model, given only a clinical protocol and a network's weights, can audit and repair the network. Networks with 433 to 4,801 parameters were trained to screen head-and-neck planning requests against four rules. Flaws were planted through the training data: confounds that hid each rule, a 3 Gy shift in the cord threshold, and a hidden trigger. Claude Opus 5.5 audited each network blind, without tools, data or code execution, and every claim and repair was tested on about 420,000 requests. The language model named the broken rule in 16 of 18 flawed networks (95% CI 67% to 97%), including all 15 with a confound or a threshold shift. It repaired each of the 16 by changing a median of 3 parameters. Fine-tuning on protocol-labeled requests also repaired every network, but changed nearly every parameter. Each confound and shift it found was visible in single units, and a simple statistic chosen for each flaw type found the same flaws. It cleared 2 of 5 healthy networks without being forced and found 1 of 3 triggers. Testing against the protocol detected every flaw, and black-box testing found the confounds and the shift faster. The results indicate that, in small networks, weight-space programming can locate and repair flaws that silence an input or shift a threshold, but cannot yet certify that a network is correct.
zh_abstract: 放射治疗中的机器学习模型是通过在已知答案的病例上进行测试而投入使用的，这种方式可能无法发现测试病例与训练数据共有的捷径。近期有报道称，前沿语言模型能够读取和写入小型神经网络的原始权重，这种能力被称为权重空间编程（weight-space programming）。本研究旨在确定，在仅给定临床方案和网络权重的情况下，此类模型能否对网络进行审计和修复。我们训练了参数量为 433 至 4,801 的网络，用于依据四条规则筛查头颈部放疗计划申请。缺陷通过训练数据植入：掩盖每条规则的混杂因素、脊髓阈值 3 Gy 的偏移，以及一个隐藏触发器。Claude Opus 5.5 对每个网络进行盲审，不使用工具、数据或代码执行，其每项判断和修复均在约 420,000 条申请上进行了检验。该语言模型在 18 个有缺陷的网络中的 16 个中指出了被破坏的规则（95% CI 67% 至 97%），其中包括全部 15 个存在混杂或阈值偏移的网络。它通过平均修改 3 个参数（中位数）修复了这 16 个网络中的每一个。使用带方案标签的申请进行微调也修复了每个网络，但几乎改变了所有参数。其发现的每一个混杂和偏移在单个单元中均可见，并且针对每种缺陷类型选取的简单统计量发现了相同的缺陷。在未被强制的情况下，它判定 5 个健康网络中的 2 个无问题，并发现了 3 个触发器中的 1 个。对照方案进行测试可检出每一个缺陷，而黑箱测试能更快地发现混杂和偏移。结果表明，在小型网络中，权重空间编程能够定位并修复使某一输入失效或使阈值偏移的缺陷，但尚不能证明网络是正确的。

title: High-Resolution Quantitative MRI Using Contrast-Domain Multiscale Energy (MuSE) Regularization
zh_title: 基于对比域多尺度能量正则的高分辨率定量MRI
summary: 预印本提出首个基于扩散模型的0.5 mm各向同性定量MRI重建，扫描不足5分钟，先验用CelebA人脸图像训练，无需MRI训练数据。
key_points: 0.5 mm分辨率，体素体积为临床的八分之一
先验作用于合成对比图像，独立于序列
MuSE模型仅用CelebA灰度人脸训练
reason: 方法新颖的预印本，临床验证有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Quantitative MRI methods can offer tissue parameter maps (e.g. T1) that are comparable across scanners, sessions and subjects, together with multiple contrast-weighted images from a single scan. However, most data are acquired at 1 mm, which limits their use in neurodegenerative diseases that affect fine brain structures. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first diffusion-model-based reconstruction for quantitative MRI at 0.5 mm isotropic resolution from scans of less than 5 minutes, which has eightfold smaller voxel volume than clinical protocols. The key idea is to apply the prior to the synthesized contrast images rather than to the subspace coefficients. The prior is then independent of the temporal basis and the sequence, which improves generalization and allows a 2-D multiscale energy (MuSE) model trained on grayscale CelebA face images to be used without any MRI training data. The explicit energy makes reconstruction MAP estimation by a step-size-free majorize-minimize algorithm that regularizes a rotating subset of contrasts along different axes, which makes 3-D multi-contrast reconstruction tractable. For 3-D radial MPnRAGE at 7 T in 4.3 min, MuSE reduced the phantom NRMSE from 0.133 (CG-SENSE) and 0.091 (L1-wavelet) to 0.074 and the WM T1 interquartile range from 117 and 47 ms to 38 ms, and it was demonstrated in vivo at 7 T.

title: Multi-Objective Generative Optimization via Expected Hypervolume Fine-Tuning
zh_title: 期望超体积微调：多目标生成式优化
summary: 提出Hypervolume Fine-Tuning，微调预训练生成模型以最大化样本期望超体积，用于分子等科学设计中的多目标权衡。
key_points: 同时奖励候选质量与整体权衡覆盖
适配单个预训练流/扩散生成器
约束与预训练分布的偏离
reason: 预印本新方法，面向科学发现，摘要缺少实验证据
abstract: Scientific discovery requires plausible designs spanning useful trade-offs among competing properties: a molecule with strong binding affinity, for example, may be difficult to synthesize. Pretrained generative models, e.g., flow and diffusion generators, provide a foundation for proposing such designs, but steering them toward high-quality, complementary trade-offs remains challenging. Inference-time search incurs high per-sample costs, while fine-tuning typically relies on fixed per-candidate rewards that do not capture how designs complement one another. We introduce Hypervolume Fine-Tuning (HVFT), which adapts a single pretrained generator to maximize the expected hypervolume of its samples while controlling departure from the pretrained distribution. Expected hypervolume jointly rewards candidate quality and collective trade-off coverage. Nonetheless, we show that it cannot be expressed as the expectation of a fixed per-candidate reward and therefore cannot be optimized directly with standard techniques. A key observation of this work is that its first variation corresponds to the expected marginal hypervolume contribution of a candidate, which yields a tractable adaptive reward via an unbiased estimator based on model samples. HVFT uses this reward to decompose the objective into a sequence of KL-proximal scalar-reward subproblems. We establish concavity, relative smoothness, and convergence guarantees for the resulting distributional procedure. Across therapeutic-peptide and molecular design tasks spanning discrete diffusion and continuous flow-matching models, HVFT achieves state-of-the-art expected hypervolume and trade-off coverage.
zh_abstract: 科学发现需要在相互竞争的性质之间实现有用权衡的合理设计：例如，结合亲和力很强的分子可能难以合成。预训练生成模型（如流模型和扩散生成器）为提出此类设计提供了基础，但要引导它们产生高质量、互补的权衡仍具挑战。推理时搜索的单样本成本很高，而微调通常依赖固定的单候选奖励，无法体现各设计之间如何互补。我们提出超体积微调（Hypervolume Fine-Tuning，HVFT），它调整单个预训练生成器，以最大化其样本的期望超体积，同时控制其与预训练分布的偏离。期望超体积同时奖励候选设计的质量和整体权衡覆盖范围。然而，我们证明它无法表示为某个固定的单候选奖励的期望，因此不能用标准技术直接优化。本工作的一个关键观察是，其一阶变分对应于候选设计的期望边际超体积贡献，由此可通过基于模型样本的无偏估计器得到可处理的自适应奖励。HVFT 利用该奖励将目标分解为一系列 KL 近端（KL-proximal）标量奖励子问题。我们为由此得到的分布式过程建立了凹性、相对光滑性和收敛性保证。在涵盖离散扩散模型和连续流匹配模型的治疗性肽和分子设计任务中，HVFT 取得了最先进的期望超体积和权衡覆盖范围。

title: Diffusion Plug-in Priors for Self-Supervised Ultrasound Video Restoration
zh_title: 扩散即插即用先验的自监督超声视频复原
summary: UltraDiff用冻结的预训练扩散模型作先验，无需配对数据或重训练，对超声视频联合超分辨与去散斑。
key_points: 优化扩散采样器潜变量种子，采用MAP形式
基于Rayleigh模型推导散斑感知保真项
无需配对训练数据与网络重训练
reason: 预印本新方法有理论推导，摘要缺少临床验证
abstract: \textit{Objective:} Ultrasound videos are limited by hardware-constrained spatial resolution and signal-dependent speckle, while paired low- and high-resolution acquisitions for supervised restoration are rarely available. We aim to jointly super-resolve and despeckle ultrasound videos without paired training data or network retraining. \textit{Methods:} We propose UltraDiff, which uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model (DM) as a plug-in prior and restores each frame by optimizing the latent seed of the DM sampler under a range-constrained maximum a posteriori formulation. We derive a speckle-aware data-fidelity term from a Rayleigh scale-family model and characterize its relative-residual and variance-adaptive weighting properties. We further introduce a stabilized fidelity that is bounded below and strictly convex in log intensity for positive observations in its unclamped form. A total-variation regularizer complements the DM prior, and a temporal seed update warm-starts each frame from the optimized seed of its predecessor. \textit{Results:} On EchoNet-LVH videos with simulated speckle and additive noise, UltraDiff with a natural-image prior improves PSNR by 1.24\,dB over the strongest baseline, and ultrasound-related priors improve it further. On real clinical echocardiography videos, UltraDiff reduces the mean absolute error of zero-shot ejection fraction (EF) prediction from 7.31 to 6.37 EF points relative to DUP, the strongest baseline. \textit{Conclusion:} Combining a speckle-aware fidelity with frozen diffusion priors enables ground-truth-free ultrasound video restoration that benefits downstream measurement. \textit{Significance:} UltraDiff needs neither paired data nor retraining and is not tied to a specific diffusion checkpoint. Code associated with this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: \textit{目的：}超声视频受限于硬件约束的空间分辨率和信号依赖的散斑，而用于监督式复原的低分辨率与高分辨率配对采集数据很少可得。我们旨在无需配对训练数据或网络重新训练的情况下，对超声视频联合进行超分辨率和去散斑。\textit{方法：}我们提出UltraDiff，它将冻结的预训练扩散模型（DM）作为即插即用先验，并在范围约束的最大后验框架下，通过优化DM采样器的潜在种子来复原每一帧。我们基于瑞利尺度族模型推导出一种散斑感知的数据保真项，并刻画了其相对残差和方差自适应加权特性。我们进一步引入一种稳定化保真项，对于正观测值，其未截断形式在对数强度上有下界且严格凸。总变分正则项对DM先验起补充作用，并且时间种子更新使每一帧以其前一帧优化后的种子作为热启动。\textit{结果：}在带有模拟散斑和加性噪声的EchoNet-LVH视频上，采用自然图像先验的UltraDiff比最强基线的PSNR提高1.24 dB，使用超声相关先验则进一步提升。在真实临床超声心动图视频上，相对于最强基线DUP，UltraDiff将零样本射血分数（EF）预测的平均绝对误差由7.31个EF点降至6.37个EF点。\textit{结论：}将散斑感知保真项与冻结的扩散先验相结合，可实现无需真值的超声视频复原，并有益于下游测量。\textit{意义：}UltraDiff既不需要配对数据也不需要重新训练，且不依赖于特定的扩散模型检查点。本工作相关代码将在论文被接收后公开。

title: Flexible Intensities Matter: A Comprehensive Re-evaluation of Hawkes Processes and Neural Temporal Point Processes
zh_title: 灵活强度很关键：Hawkes过程与神经时间点过程的再评估
summary: 预印本系统比较Hawkes与神经TPP，含UK Biobank疾病史和MIMIC-IV任务，发现放宽Hawkes灵活性后二者差距大幅缩小。
key_points: 覆盖五个基准及两个大规模医学任务
既往报告的差距在灵活Hawkes下基本消失
任务为自回归下一事件预测
reason: 对比充分的方法再评估，含大规模医学数据，但为预印本
abstract: Temporal point processes (TPPs) are the canonical framework for event sequence data, with applications spanning seismology, social media, and electronic health records. Recently, neural TPPs have been reported to substantially outperform classical TPPs, such as Hawkes processes, but these comparisons pitted flexible neural models against Hawkes processes in their most restricted form, and did not consider large-scale medical data. Here, we revisit this comparison through a systematic evaluation of Poisson and Hawkes processes of increasing flexibility against neural TPPs, on five established benchmark datasets and on two large-scale medical evaluation tasks derived from UK Biobank disease histories and MIMIC-IV ICU records, under autoregressive next-event prediction. First, the previously reported gap between Hawkes processes and neural TPPs largely disappears once Hawkes processes are equipped with flexible, learnable baselines and kernels. Second, the flexibility of the intensity parametrization also limits prior neural TPPs: a Transformer with a spline-based intensity head outperforms previous intensity-based neural TPPs and is on par with the intensity-free model. Decomposing the log-likelihood into a time term $\log p(t)$ and a type term $\log p(d \mid t)$, we find that this flexibility advantage lies almost entirely in the time density: more flexibility does not improve the type term. On these benchmarks, the gains of neural TPPs thus lie mostly in modeling when events occur, not which. Third, our results underscore the value of complex datasets for evaluating TPPs: only on the MIMIC-IV ICU records do neural TPPs retain an advantage in the type term. Our results inform both future method development and model choice. We release our framework, TorchPP, as an open-source package with consistent implementations of classical and neural TPPs.
zh_abstract: 时间点过程（TPP）是事件序列数据的经典框架，应用涵盖地震学、社交媒体和电子健康记录。近来有报道称神经TPP显著优于Hawkes过程等经典TPP，但这些比较是将灵活的神经模型与最受限形式的Hawkes过程相比较，并且未考虑大规模医学数据。在此，我们通过系统评估重新审视这一比较：在五个公认的基准数据集，以及两个源自UK Biobank疾病史和MIMIC-IV ICU记录的大规模医学评估任务上，在自回归下一事件预测设定下，将灵活性逐步增强的Poisson过程和Hawkes过程与神经TPP进行比较。第一，一旦为Hawkes过程配备灵活、可学习的基线和核函数，先前报道的Hawkes过程与神经TPP之间的差距在很大程度上消失。第二，强度参数化的灵活性也限制了既往的神经TPP：带有基于样条的强度头的Transformer优于以往基于强度的神经TPP，并与无强度（intensity-free）模型相当。将对数似然分解为时间项 $\log p(t)$ 和类型项 $\log p(d \mid t)$ 后，我们发现这种灵活性优势几乎完全体现在时间密度上：更高的灵活性并不能改善类型项。因此在这些基准上，神经TPP的增益主要在于建模事件何时发生，而非发生何种事件。第三，我们的结果凸显了复杂数据集对评估TPP的价值：只有在MIMIC-IV ICU记录上，神经TPP才在类型项上保持优势。我们的结果可为未来的方法开发和模型选择提供参考。我们将框架TorchPP作为开源软件包发布，其中包含经典TPP和神经TPP的一致实现。

title: C-WFDM: A ControlNet-Guided Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Brain MRI Completion
zh_title: C-WFDM：ControlNet引导的小波融合扩散模型用于多模态脑MRI补全
summary: 预印本提出扩散模型补全合并神经影像数据中缺失的MRI模态，针对T1w、T2w、FLAIR、T1Gd可得性不均的实际情况。
key_points: ControlNet引导并融合小波特征
针对公共数据集中真实的模态缺失模式
摘要未给出具体性能数据
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，贴近真实缺失模式，但证据有限
abstract: Multimodal brain MRI provides complementary anatomical, tissue, and pathological information to support downstream artificial intelligence (AI) applications. However, modality availability is uneven across public and pooled neuroimaging datasets: T1-weighted (T1w) MRI is widely represented, T2-weighted (T2w) and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) MRI are less consistently available, and gadolinium-enhanced T1-weighted (T1Gd) MRI is relatively scarce. Pooled datasets therefore contain participants with different combinations of acquired MRI contrasts, reflecting variation in the study designs, acquisition protocols, and clinical or research objectives of the contributing studies. Many missing-modality benchmarks simulate incomplete MRI by withholding contrasts from complete four-modality cases, which may not represent the observed availability patterns in pooled datasets. To address this gap, we introduce C-WFDM, a ControlNet extension of our Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model (WFDM), for subject-specific missing-modality completion. C-WFDM is built on an earlier BrainScape snapshot comprising 157 public MRI datasets and 45,880 preprocessed scans. The pretrained WFDM backbone retains target-modality and metadata conditioning, while target-specific ControlNet adapters use MRI contrasts from the same participant to guide synthesis. C-WFDM synthesizes T2w from T1w, FLAIR from T1w and T2w, and T1Gd from T1w, T2w, and FLAIR. Acquired conditioning contrasts are used when available, and generated intermediate contrasts are used only when required. We compare C-WFDM with ALDM, cWDM, and Pix2Pix using paired structural similarity index (SSIM), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), and mean absolute error (MAE). In the BrainScape completion experiment, C-WFDM achieves the best T2w and FLAIR results among the evaluated models, with SSIM values of 0.9232 and 0.8904, respectively.
zh_abstract: 多模态脑部 MRI 可提供互补的解剖、组织和病理信息，以支持下游人工智能（AI）应用。然而，在公开和合并的神经影像数据集中，各模态的可获得性并不均衡：T1 加权（T1w）MRI 的代表性广泛，T2 加权（T2w）和液体衰减反转恢复（FLAIR）MRI 的可获得性不够一致，而钆增强 T1 加权（T1Gd）MRI 则相对稀缺。因此，合并数据集中的参与者具有不同的 MRI 对比组合，这反映了各来源研究在研究设计、采集方案以及临床或研究目标方面的差异。许多缺失模态基准通过从完整的四模态病例中人为扣除某些对比来模拟不完整的 MRI，这可能无法代表合并数据集中实际观察到的可获得性模式。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了 C-WFDM，它是我们的小波融合扩散模型（Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model，WFDM）的 ControlNet 扩展，用于针对个体的缺失模态补全。C-WFDM 构建于较早的 BrainScape 快照之上，该快照包含 157 个公开 MRI 数据集和 45,880 份预处理扫描。预训练的 WFDM 主干保留了目标模态和元数据条件，而针对特定目标的 ControlNet 适配器则利用同一参与者的 MRI 对比来引导合成。C-WFDM 可由 T1w 合成 T2w，由 T1w 和 T2w 合成 FLAIR，并由 T1w、T2w 和 FLAIR 合成 T1Gd。在可获得时使用已采集的条件对比，仅在需要时才使用生成的中间对比。我们使用配对的结构相似性指数（SSIM）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）和平均绝对误差（MAE），将 C-WFDM 与 ALDM、cWDM 和 Pix2Pix 进行比较。在 BrainScape 补全实验中，C-WFDM 在所评估的模型中取得了最佳的 T2w 和 FLAIR 结果，SSIM 值分别为 0.9232 和 0.8904。

title: CoRTeC: A Differentially Private Release for Synthetic Tabular Data, Decodable by Any Generator
zh_title: CoRTeC：差分隐私的合成表格数据发布方法
summary: 提出CoRTeC，仅一次性消耗隐私预算发布带噪计数文件，任何生成器均可解码为合成表格数据，用于医院等无法共享的记录。
key_points: 隐私预算只花在一份带噪计数文件上
文件可在发布前由审核者逐项检查
解码生成合成数据无需额外隐私成本
reason: 有新意的隐私方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: The records that could train the most useful models, such as a hospital's patient files, are often the ones an institution cannot share. We propose CoRTeC, a method that releases synthetic versions of such records under differential privacy. Differential privacy places a proven limit on what the synthetic data can reveal about any person, and in particular on membership inference. CoRTeC spends the privacy budget once, on a small file of noisy counts designed for training a classifier. For each group of records, the file gives the group's size, its balance of outcomes, a histogram of every column for each outcome and the outcome rate in each of several non-overlapping cells. A reviewer can check every number before the file leaves the institution. Anyone can then turn the counts into synthetic rows, as often as they like and at no further privacy cost. A maximum-entropy decoder can do this without any language model, and so can each of the five frozen language models we tested. None of them ever sees a real record. A selection step then matches the rows to the released counts. Decoded without a language model, the automatically configured release at $\varepsilon = 2$ trains classifiers to within 0.02 AUC of a real sample of the same size on the Adult dataset, across three data splits. On NHANES and bank marketing, without the selection step, it stays within 0.05 AUC. On Adult, with a fixed cohort rule, the release carries the outcome rates a deployment names more closely than a real sample does, at some cost in accuracy on pairs of columns. Four controls show that most of the utility comes from the release and the selection step, and that a language model adds what it knows from the column names. No private row ever reaches a model, and no row CoRTeC generates copies a real one. The strongest membership attack stays far below the bound the budget allows.

title: PathoS2VD: From 2D Histopathology to Pseudo Z-Stack Representations
zh_title: PathoS2VD：从2D组织病理到伪Z-stack表示
summary: 提出基于图像到视频潜在扩散模型的生成框架，从病理z-stack学习轴向形态先验，将单层2D切片合成伪z-stack。

从z-stack数据学习z轴形态先验
可作为专用体积成像的低成本替代

abstract: For decades, diagnostic pathology has relied on thin two-dimensional (2D) tissue sections, despite biological tissues exhibiting inherently three-dimensional (3D) morphological organization. Because a single section captures only one focal plane, important morphological cues along the z-axis are inevitably discarded, limiting tissue representation for both human interpretation and computational analysis. In this work, we propose a generative framework that learns z-axis morphological priors from pathology z-stack data, offering a cost-effective alternative to dedicated volumetric imaging, and transfers this knowledge to conventional single-plane histopathology. Specifically, an image-to-video (I2V) latent diffusion model (LDM) is trained to synthesize a pseudo z-stack from a single 2D image, capturing plausible morphological variations across adjacent focal planes rather than reconstructing physical tissue volumes. To enable deployment on large-scale clinical datasets without native z-stack acquisition, we further introduce a prior-preserving mixture fine-tuning strategy that adapts the model to new domains while retaining the learned z-axis morphological prior. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the synthesized pseudo z-stacks exhibit realistic cross-plane morphological continuity and consistently improve downstream prostate cancer classification compared with conventional 2D representations. Our results suggest that learning transferable z-axis priors from limited z-stack data provides a practical way to enrich routine pathology images with complementary morphological information. Code: https://github.com/QuIIL/PathoS2VD.

title: VirtualTrialHarness: Coordinating Agentic Operationalization of Virtual Trial Protocols Across Complex Clinical Schemas
zh_title: VirtualTrialHarness：虚拟试验方案的智能体化落地
summary: 提出智能体框架VTHarness，协调虚拟试验方案在复杂临床数据模式下的可执行化，并发布VTBenchmark评估数据源选择与队列构建。
key_points: 按流程阶段选择可复用技能并用显式契约保持一致
提出VTBenchmark评估来源选择与队列构建
在三个复杂合成环境中测试

abstract: Virtual trials use routinely collected clinical data to evaluate treatment strategies, but translating a study protocol into an executable analysis requires determining how clinical concepts and study requirements should be represented in the available data and applied consistently across the workflow. These decisions depend on local data representations and operational conventions and can involve source selection, patient and encounter identity, linkage, and temporal interpretation. Here we introduce VirtualTrialHarness (VTHarness), an agent framework that coordinates virtual-trial operationalization by selecting reusable procedural skills for each workflow stage and uses explicit contracts to maintain consistent study decisions across stages. We also introduce VTBenchmark for evaluating source selection and cohort construction. Across three complex synthetic environments, VTHarness successfully produced all required cohort outputs matching the references in 95.1% of workflows after requirement clarification, compared with 60.4% using retrieval from the same procedural corpus. Procedural skills improved source recovery across three language models and increased source overlap with analyst code in 13 Mayo Clinic cases. Site-specific adaptation enabled reference-matched cohort execution across eight MIMIC-IV tasks. Within the Mayo Clinic Virtual Trials Program, the framework supported investigator review of cohort construction and endpoint analysis. These findings support coordinating procedural guidance with workflow decisions to improve virtual-trial implementation across complex clinical schemas.

title: Mitigating Spurious Invariance in Contrastive Learning: A Probabilistic Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Medical Image Analysis
zh_title: 缓解对比学习伪不变性：医学图像概率自监督框架
summary: 将特征嵌入编码为概率分布而非固定向量，提出统一概率自监督框架，称在医学影像任务上优于现有方法。
key_points: 指出增强可能抑制关键医学特征
以概率分布表示嵌入
统一整合多种SSL方法
