abstract: Owing to the prohibitive cost of manual annotation for enormous medical images, self-supervised learning (SSL) has gained substantial attention and shown promise in various medical imaging tasks. Among SSL approaches, contrastive learning has emerged as a prominent one, encouraging models to encode semantic information that remains invariant between different augmented views. However, this invariance can be spurious for medical images, as subtle but critical medical features can be suppressed during augmentations. In this paper, we mitigate this issue by encoding the learned feature embeddings as probability distributions rather than fixed vectors, thus capturing a richer and more nuanced spectrum of information. Furthermore, we propose a unified probabilistic framework that seamlessly integrates multiple SSL approaches. Our method achieves superior performance over the state-of-the-art SSL methods on various downstream tasks across multiple datasets, including medical image segmentation and classification. We further validate the method through additional analyses of robustness to stronger augmentations, label efficiency under limited fine-tuning labels, and computational trade-offs. The code is released at https://github.com/wwzjer/ProbSSL.
zh_abstract: 由于为海量医学图像进行人工标注的成本过高，自监督学习（SSL）受到了广泛关注，并在多种医学影像任务中展现出前景。在SSL方法中，对比学习已成为一类突出的方法，它促使模型编码在不同增强视图之间保持不变的语义信息。然而，对于医学图像而言，这种不变性可能是虚假的，因为细微但关键的医学特征可能在增强过程中被抑制。在本文中，我们通过将学习到的特征嵌入编码为概率分布而非固定向量来缓解这一问题，从而捕获更丰富、更细致的信息谱。此外，我们提出了一个统一的概率框架，可无缝整合多种SSL方法。我们的方法在多个数据集上的各类下游任务（包括医学图像分割和分类）中，性能优于最先进的SSL方法。我们还通过对更强增强的鲁棒性、有限微调标签下的标签效率以及计算权衡等额外分析，进一步验证了该方法。代码已发布于 https://github.com/wwzjer/ProbSSL。

title: Recasting Visual Language Models as EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Neurodiagnostics
zh_title: 将视觉语言模型改造为临床神经诊断的脑电基础模型
summary: 预印本探讨通用视觉语言模型能否通过可视化读取脑电图，无需大规模脑电预训练即可用于临床神经诊断任务。
key_points: 让VLM以视觉方式判读脑电图
无需大规模脑电预训练
对比任务特异监督与脑电基础模型范式

abstract: Historically automated electroencephalography (EEG) systems was done using task-specific supervised models trained on purposely annotated data. A more recent modeling paradigm relies on creating a unified representation, or a 'foundation model', for multiple modality-specific tasks through large-scale domain-specific pretraining on the unannotated EEG signal. The quality of this unified representation directly depends on the availability of the modality-specific datasets. At the same time, generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) exhibit broad few-shot learning capacities as well as good fine-tuning adaptability to different visual and language tasks. Can VLMs learn how to read and interpret EEG visually, emulating to a degree the way human clinicians inspect the EEG patterns? In this work we make a case that they can: we show that generalist VLMs without large-scale EEG pretraining perform competitively across a collection of clinical neuro-diagnostic tasks, can adapt to different tasks in a few-shot learning setting better than specialist foundation models, and exhibit better performance with model scaling when modality-specific models fail to exhibit.
zh_abstract: 历史上，自动化脑电图（EEG）系统是使用在专门标注数据上训练的任务特定监督模型完成的。较新的建模范式则依赖于通过在未标注EEG信号上进行大规模领域特定预训练，为多个模态特定任务建立统一表示，即“基础模型”。这种统一表示的质量直接取决于模态特定数据集的可得性。与此同时，通用视觉语言模型（VLM）表现出广泛的少样本学习能力，并对各种视觉和语言任务具有良好的微调适应性。VLM能否学会以视觉方式读取并解释EEG，在一定程度上模拟人类临床医生检查EEG模式的方式？在这项工作中我们论证了这一点是可行的：我们表明，未经大规模EEG预训练的通用VLM在一系列临床神经诊断任务中表现具有竞争力，在少样本学习设置下比专用基础模型更好地适应不同任务，并且随着模型规模扩大表现更好，而模态特定模型则未表现出这一点。

title: Mammography datasets and artificial intelligence for breast cancer detection: challenges, bias, and future directions.
zh_title: 乳腺X线数据集与AI乳腺癌检测：挑战、偏倚与未来方向
summary: 综述以数据为中心，分析公开乳腺X线数据集特征及其对AI乳腺癌检测性能与临床泛化的影响。
key_points: 比较公开乳腺X线数据集特征
讨论数据对模型性能与泛化的作用
涉及数据偏倚与未来方向

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Breast cancer is still one of the main causes of death in women from cancer worldwide, and early detection is crucial. Mammography is the primary imaging modality for breast cancer screening and recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have significantly enhanced automated breast cancer detection. This review takes a data-centered approach, examining key characteristics of public datasets, the contributions of mammography data to AI for breast cancer detection, and the implications for clinical generalizability. This review, however, takes a data-centered approach, critically analyzing characteristics of publicly available mammography datasets, and the role of mammography data to the development, performance and clinical generalization of AI models for the detection of breast cancer. The datasets are compared on the following aspects: dataset size, quality of the annotations, imaging modality, clinical metadata, dataset accessibility and demographic diversity. Analysis reveals that the quality, diversity and representativeness of the data used are critical for the performance and generalizability of AI models, ranging from the traditional machine learning era to the current era of deep learning, transformer-based systems, multimodal learning, explainable AI and privacy-preserving learning. The results show that, apart from the development of AI model architectures, it is a necessity to have standardized, diverse and clinically representative datasets to make further progress in AI-assisted mammography. The review emphasizes the importance of establishing a comprehensive benchmark dataset for mammography that is large and diverse to enhance reproducibility, to fairly evaluate models, and to develop strong, clinically viable AI systems for breast cancer detection.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 乳腺癌仍是全球女性癌症死亡的主要原因之一，早期发现至关重要。乳腺 X 线摄影是乳腺癌筛查的主要影像学手段，人工智能（AI）的最新进展显著提升了乳腺癌的自动检测能力。本综述采用以数据为中心的方法，考察公开数据集的关键特征、乳腺 X 线摄影数据对用于乳腺癌检测的 AI 的贡献，以及对临床可推广性的影响。本综述以数据为中心，批判性地分析了公开可用的乳腺 X 线摄影数据集的特征，以及乳腺 X 线摄影数据在乳腺癌检测 AI 模型的开发、性能和临床泛化中的作用。数据集在以下方面进行了比较：数据集规模、标注质量、成像方式、临床元数据、数据集可获取性和人口统计学多样性。分析表明，从传统机器学习时代到当前的深度学习、基于 Transformer 的系统、多模态学习、可解释 AI 和隐私保护学习时代，所用数据的质量、多样性和代表性对 AI 模型的性能和可推广性都至关重要。结果表明，除了 AI 模型架构的发展之外，还必须拥有标准化、多样化且具有临床代表性的数据集，才能在 AI 辅助乳腺 X 线摄影方面取得进一步进展。本综述强调，建立一个大型且多样化的乳腺 X 线摄影综合基准数据集十分重要，这有助于提高可重复性、公平评估模型，并开发强大且临床可行的乳腺癌检测 AI 系统。

title: Federated Transfer Learning for Medical Image Classification under Mixed Skew
zh_title: 混合偏斜下用于医学图像分类的联邦迁移学习
summary: 提出PAFP个性化联邦学习框架，基于预训练骨干并加入客户端特定特征对齐模块，应对多中心混合偏斜。
key_points: 针对特征、标签、概念与数量偏斜
基于预训练骨干而非从头训练
客户端特定特征对齐模块
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，证据有限
abstract: Deep learning in medical imaging is constrained by data scarcity and by privacy regulations that make centralizing patient data across institutions impractical. Federated Learning (FL) addresses these constraints by keeping data local, but its distributed nature exposes training to strong statistical heterogeneity. Multicentric medical data is particularly affected, exhibiting a mixed skew that combines feature, label, concept, and quantity shifts across centers. Personalized FL mitigates heterogeneity by tailoring a model to each client, yet most methods assume training from scratch, which is unrealistic given the high dimensionality of medical features relative to the limited data available. We propose the Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained (PAFP) framework, a personalized FL approach built on a pre-trained backbone. PAFP inserts client-specific Feature Alignment modules before the fine-tuned blocks to realign hidden feature distributions toward a server-aggregated target. On the FedISIC benchmark, PAFP attains the highest unweighted balanced accuracy while reducing inter-client performance variance roughly six-fold relative to the strongest baseline, yielding accuracy and cross-client equity jointly. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP.
zh_abstract: 医学影像中的深度学习受限于数据稀缺以及隐私法规，后者使得跨机构集中患者数据不切实际。联邦学习（FL）通过将数据保留在本地来应对这些限制，但其分布式特性使训练面临强烈的统计异质性。多中心医学数据尤其受影响，表现为各中心之间同时存在特征、标签、概念和数量偏移的混合偏斜。个性化联邦学习通过为每个客户端定制模型来缓解异质性，但大多数方法假定从头开始训练，而鉴于医学特征的高维度相对于可用数据有限，这并不现实。我们提出了 Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained（PAFP）框架，这是一种建立在预训练主干网络之上的个性化 FL 方法。PAFP 在微调模块之前插入客户端特定的特征对齐（Feature Alignment）模块，以将隐藏特征分布重新对齐到由服务器聚合得到的目标。在 FedISIC 基准上，PAFP 获得了最高的未加权平衡准确率，同时相对于最强基线将客户端间性能方差降低了约六倍，从而同时实现了准确率与跨客户端公平性。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/Alexandre-Leclercq/PAFP。

title: Molecular Prior Networks
zh_title: 分子先验网络：用于药物-靶点亲和力预测
summary: 受表格基础模型PFN启发，预印本提出一种亲和力建模方法，针对小数据集场景，通过单次前向传播预测查询分子的标签。

借鉴Prior-data Fitted Networks思路
利用Transformer单次前向完成预测

abstract: Predicting affinity between small molecules and their protein targets remains one of the central problems in drug discovery. Due to the substantial cost of wet-lab experiments, machine learning models of drug-target affinity are usually trained on relatively small datasets, ranging from tens to hundreds of molecules. Given the inherent difficulty of generalization between different targets and chemical series, existing datasets of protein-ligand affinities are typically not used for new projects. At the same time, tabular foundation models, including Prior-data Fitted Networks, have recently shown how transformers can be used to solve machine learning problems in a single forward pass of the network, after being trained over a large corpus of, typically, synthetic datasets. Inspired by that line of work, we propose a novel affinity modelling approach, in which the labels of the query molecules are predicted from the labelled support molecules in a single forward pass of a transformer model. The model is trained on thousands of existing affinity datasets, enabling it to capture the general patterns of molecular activity across different targets, chemical series and dataset sizes. For the smallest support sets, our model matches the state of the art on the regression variant of the FS-Mol benchmark, while being faster than existing methods, thanks to the lack of task-specific training. A comparison against a reduced variant of our architecture, which amounts to kernel regression in a meta-learned feature space, shows that the predictive performance of the transformer model is only partially explained by simple molecular similarity.
zh_abstract: 预测小分子与其蛋白靶点之间的亲和力仍是药物发现的核心问题之一。由于湿实验成本高昂，药物-靶点亲和力的机器学习模型通常在相对较小的数据集（从数十到数百个分子）上训练。鉴于不同靶点和化学系列之间泛化的固有困难，现有的蛋白-配体亲和力数据集通常不会用于新项目。与此同时，包括先验数据拟合网络（Prior-data Fitted Networks）在内的表格基础模型最近表明，在大量（通常为合成的）数据集语料上训练后，Transformer可在网络的单次前向传递中解决机器学习问题。受这一系列工作启发，我们提出了一种新的亲和力建模方法：在Transformer模型的单次前向传递中，根据带标签的支持分子预测查询分子的标签。该模型在数千个现有亲和力数据集上训练，使其能够捕捉不同靶点、化学系列和数据集规模下分子活性的一般规律。对于最小的支持集，我们的模型在FS-Mol基准的回归版本上达到了最先进水平，同时由于无需针对任务的训练，速度快于现有方法。与我们架构的一个简化变体（相当于元学习特征空间中的核回归）相比，结果表明Transformer模型的预测性能只能被简单的分子相似性部分解释。

title: Disentangling Context-Specific Alzheimer's Disease Progression Signatures through an Explainable AI Framework
zh_title: 可解释AI框架解析阿尔茨海默病进展的情境特异性特征
summary: 提出ADVISE可解释深度生成框架，从人类前额叶大规模单核RNA测序数据中分离Braak分期相关转录信号，识别全局、性别和细胞类型特异的进展特征。

借助可解释AI对基因和通路进行优先级排序

abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression involves stage-dependent transcriptional changes that are often masked by dominant cellular and biological variation. Here, we present ADVISE (Alzheimer's Disease Variational Isolation of Signal Embeddings), an interpretable deep generative framework designed to disentangle Braak stage-associated transcriptional signals from background biological variation through separate latent representations. Using explainable AI, ADVISE prioritizes genes and pathways contributing to the disease-specific representation. Applying ADVISE to large-scale single-nucleus RNA sequencing data from the human prefrontal cortex, we identify shared and context-specific signatures of AD progression across global, sex-specific, and cell-type-specific analyses, revealing convergent molecular programs involving synaptic transmission, HSF1-associated proteostatic stress responses, and SLIT/ROBO axon guidance. Notably, ADVISE prioritizes ROBO2 as a progression-associated candidate in excitatory neurons. Experimental validation using CRISPR activation in hiPSC-derived excitatory neurons demonstrates that ROBO2 activation reduces the phosphorylated Tau-to-total Tau ratio. ADVISE thus reveals context-dependent molecular signatures of AD progression and bridges human single-cell discoveries with experimental validation of candidate regulators of AD pathology.

title: XAMPGen: An Interpretable SI Pipeline For Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Discovery
zh_title: XAMPGen：可解释的新型抗菌肽发现流程
summary: 在已知抗菌肽上微调蛋白语言模型ProGen以生成新肽序列，并用探针分类器、回归器和自注意力分析解释模型内部表征。
key_points: 微调解码器型蛋白语言模型ProGen生成抗菌肽
用探针分类器与回归器定位关键层
对这些层做自注意力分析以获得生物学见解
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，可解释性分析，但证据有限，未见实验验证信息
abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are short peptides with a broad spectrum of activity against bacterial pathogens, representing a promising avenue for combating the growing threat of antibiotic resistance. This study focuses on two main components: 1) generating novel AMPs with desired properties using generative SI (GenSI) and 2) utilizing explainable SI (XSI) methods to validate the GenSI model and derive biological insights. In this work, we fine-tuned ProGen, a decoder-only protein language model, on known AMPs to generate novel peptide sequences with strong antimicrobial properties. To advance the interpretability and reliability of the generative model, we applied Explainable SI (XSI) techniques. Specifically, we used a probing classifier and a regressor to identify cornerstone layers that encode functionally critical information. Self-attention analysis within these layers revealed residue level interdependencies and patterns underlying antimicrobial functions, which we validated against well-characterized AMPs from the literature. Overall, these methods provide mechanistic insight into the model's decision-making process, offering a principled basis for trusting the sequences it generates rather than treating the model as a black box. Candidate sequences were filtered based on predicted Minimum Inhibitory Concentration (MIC) along with human insights into the structural activities of the AMPs in bacterial membranes, and a final set of peptides was selected for experimental testing. Biological assays for determining MIC confirmed antimicrobial activity in all generated and tested peptides, with fluorescence and circular dichroism measurements providing structural insight. With our XSI approach, we are able to reveal correlations between amino acid sequence patterns and binding properties of these sequences to bacterial membrane mimics, that directly correlate with biological activities in cell-based assays. This builds confidence in that the learned amino acid interdependencies as applied to AMPs carries physico-chemical meaning and is relevant for discoveries of novel AMPs with therapeutic potential. This work demonstrates that interpretable generative language models can serve as effective and transparent tools for rational AMP discovery.
zh_abstract: 抗菌肽（AMPs）是对细菌病原体具有广谱活性的短肽，为应对日益严重的抗生素耐药威胁提供了一条有前景的途径。本研究聚焦于两个主要部分：1）利用生成式SI（GenSI）生成具有所需特性的新型AMPs；2）利用可解释SI（XSI）方法验证GenSI模型并获得生物学见解。在这项工作中，我们在已知AMPs上对仅解码器的蛋白质语言模型ProGen进行了微调，以生成具有较强抗菌特性的新型肽序列。为提高生成模型的可解释性和可靠性，我们应用了可解释SI（XSI）技术。具体而言，我们使用探针分类器和回归器来识别编码功能关键信息的核心层。对这些层内自注意力的分析揭示了残基水平的相互依赖关系以及抗菌功能背后的模式，并已对照文献中特征明确的AMPs进行了验证。总体而言，这些方法为模型的决策过程提供了机制层面的见解，为信任其生成的序列提供了原则性依据，而非将模型视为黑箱。候选序列根据预测的最低抑菌浓度（MIC），并结合人类对AMPs在细菌膜中结构活性的认识进行筛选，最终选出一组肽用于实验检测。测定MIC的生物学实验证实，所有生成并检测的肽均具有抗菌活性，荧光和圆二色谱测量则提供了结构方面的信息。通过我们的XSI方法，我们能够揭示氨基酸序列模式与这些序列对细菌膜模拟物的结合特性之间的相关性，而这些特性与基于细胞的实验中的生物活性直接相关。这增强了人们的信心，即所学到的氨基酸相互依赖关系应用于AMPs时具有物理化学意义，并与发现具有治疗潜力的新型AMPs相关。这项工作表明，可解释的生成式语言模型可以成为合理发现AMPs的有效且透明的工具。

title: Rho: A Purpose-Driven Workspace for Human-AI Collaborative Analysis
zh_title: Rho：面向人机协作分析的目的驱动工作空间
summary: bioRxiv 预印本，提出Rho人机协作分析环境，按当前科学目的组织材料，作为研究者阅读界面与智能体续接上下文。
key_points: 针对智能体辅助生信中的结果判断瓶颈
组织状态由研究者与智能体共享
摘要主要介绍设计，未见评估结果
reason: 人机协作科学发现系统，预印本，评估信息不足
abstract: Agent-assisted bioinformatics has moved the bottleneck from computing a result to judging it: whether a comparison answers the intended question, on which unit of replication, at which version of the input, and what would change the conclusion. These judgments need materials that are usually scattered across conversations, notebooks, figures, run logs and notes, while the agent's context is a transcript rather than the structure the researcher is actually reading. We present Rho, a human--AI collaborative analysis environment that organizes materials by the current scientific purpose: it selects or obtains the materials a judgment needs, declares the relations they serve, composes operable views, and makes this organization a shared state that is at once the researcher's reading interface and the agent's continuation context. We present the design in three parts: a method object---the operations that form a round-trip, the kinds of state that must stay distinct, and the protocol invariants that make each distinction checkable; a three-layer architecture that separates capability providers from the application that composes them; and five illustrative analyses on public data. In a bulk RNA-seq case the recomputed counts differed from the published counts and the interface kept the computation, the choices and the discrepancy available for inspection; a single-nucleus case makes sample-level replication visible behind a cell-level comparison. Under one configuration these analyses show how the design behaves in practice; we present the work as a design contribution rather than an evaluation, and usability, comparative benefit and the scientific validity of individual analyses remain to be evaluated.
zh_abstract: 智能体辅助的生物信息学已将瓶颈从计算出结果转移到判断结果：某项比较是否回答了预期问题、基于哪一重复单位、针对输入的哪个版本，以及哪些因素会改变结论。这些判断所需的材料通常分散在对话、笔记本、图表、运行日志和笔记中，而智能体的上下文是一份对话记录，而非研究者实际阅读的结构。我们提出 Rho，一种人机协作分析环境，它按当前的科学目的组织材料：选择或获取判断所需的材料，声明这些材料所服务的关系，组合出可操作的视图，并使这种组织成为一种共享状态，同时作为研究者的阅读界面和智能体的延续上下文。我们分三部分介绍该设计：一个方法对象——构成往返循环的操作、必须保持区分的状态类型，以及使每种区分可被检验的协议不变式；一个将能力提供者与组合它们的应用程序分离开来的三层架构；以及基于公开数据的五个示例分析。在一个批量 RNA-seq 案例中，重新计算得到的计数与已发表的计数不同，而界面保留了计算过程、所作选择以及差异，供检查之用；在一个单细胞核案例中，样本水平的重复性在细胞水平比较的背后得以显现。这些分析在同一配置下展示了该设计在实践中的表现；我们将这项工作作为一项设计贡献而非评估来呈现，其可用性、相对获益以及各项分析的科学有效性仍有待评估。

title: MicrobeRT: A Framework and Suite of Fine-tuned Language Models for Genomic Sequences
zh_title: MicrobeRT：用于基因组序列的微调语言模型套件
summary: 基于 Nucleotide Transformer、DNABERT 等预训练基因组语言模型微调，用于宏基因组读段的物种分类、耐药基因检测与致病性评估。
key_points: 覆盖物种鉴定、耐药基因、致病性三任务
基于三个预训练基因组语言模型
面向感染病监测的宏基因组分析
reason: 基因组语言模型微调套件，预印本，验证信息不足
abstract: Accurate and reproducible metagenomic analysis is essential for effective infectious disease surveillance. Targeted diagnostics such as culturing, antigen assays, and multiplex PCR panels identify only predefined organisms and can fail to identify atypical or novel infections. Shotgun metagenomics offers hypothesis-free detection, but adoption is limited by workflow complexity, dependence on mutable reference databases, and high computational cost. To combat these challenges, we introduce MicrobeRT, an integrated suite of genomic language models fine-tuned to classify metagenomic sequencing reads across three tasks: (i) species level taxonomic identification, (ii) antibiotic resistance gene detection, and (iii) pathogenicity assessment. The framework builds on three pre-trained genomic language models - Nucleotide Transformer (Dalla-Torre et al 2025), DNABERT (Ji et al 2021, Zhou et al 2024), and HyenaDNA (Nguyen et al 2024) - leveraging their large-scale genomic pre-training, adaptability to downstream tasks, and, in the case of HyenaDNA, ability to capture long-range sequence dependencies. The models are fine-tuned on large, curated datasets spanning microbial, viral, fungal, and human genomes, including more than 500,000 genomes and 250,000 antibiotic resistance gene sequences. To evaluate the performance of our fine-tuned genomic language models across classification tasks, we developed a benchmarking framework that compares MicrobeRT against state-of-the-art (SOTA) bioinformatics tools. Across both simulated and empirical datasets, the models achieve strong performance while reducing computational overhead. MicrobeRT is released as open-source software, enabling further fine-tuning and reproducible integration of alternative models and classifiers. We also demonstrate seamless, drop-in integration by incorporating our fine-tuned taxonomic classification models as an optional add-on within the open-source TaxTriage pipeline (Merritt et al 2026). MicrobeRT demonstrates the feasibility of three clinically relevant multi-label analyses, offering a practical path to scalable, reproducible metagenomic diagnostics and enabling broader deployment of AI/ML-enhanced infectious disease testing.
zh_abstract: 准确且可重复的宏基因组分析对于有效的传染病监测至关重要。培养、抗原检测和多重 PCR 检测板等靶向诊断方法只能识别预先设定的生物体，可能无法识别非典型或新发感染。鸟枪法宏基因组学可进行无假设检测，但其应用受限于工作流程复杂、依赖可变的参考数据库以及计算成本高。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 MicrobeRT，这是一套集成的基因组语言模型，经微调后可在三项任务中对宏基因组测序读段进行分类：（i）物种水平的分类学鉴定，（ii）抗生素耐药基因检测，以及（iii）致病性评估。该框架建立在三个预训练基因组语言模型之上——Nucleotide Transformer（Dalla-Torre 等，2025）、DNABERT（Ji 等，2021；Zhou 等，2024）和 HyenaDNA（Nguyen 等，2024）——利用它们的大规模基因组预训练、对下游任务的适应性，以及（就 HyenaDNA 而言）捕获长程序列依赖的能力。这些模型在涵盖微生物、病毒、真菌和人类基因组的大型精选数据集上进行微调，其中包括 500,000 多个基因组和 250,000 条抗生素耐药基因序列。为评估我们微调的基因组语言模型在各分类任务中的表现，我们开发了一个基准测试框架，将 MicrobeRT 与最先进（SOTA）的生物信息学工具进行比较。在模拟数据集和实际数据集上，这些模型均取得了出色的性能，同时降低了计算开销。MicrobeRT 以开源软件形式发布，可进一步微调，并可实现替代模型和分类器的可重复集成。我们还通过将微调后的分类学分类模型作为可选附加组件纳入开源 TaxTriage 流程（Merritt 等，2026），展示了其无缝即插即用式集成。MicrobeRT 证明了三种具有临床意义的多标签分析的可行性，为可扩展、可重复的宏基因组诊断提供了切实可行的途径，并有助于更广泛地部署 AI/ML 增强的传染病检测。

title: Omics-scale decoding of protein N-glycosylation using protein language model embeddings
zh_title: 利用蛋白语言模型嵌入解码蛋白N-糖基化的组学尺度研究
summary: 提出零样本框架MaskNGly，借助蛋白语言模型嵌入识别N-糖基化位点，性能可比有监督预测器。
key_points: 基于共进化分析解码pLM嵌入
零样本，无需下游监督训练
可用于蛋白质组尺度糖基化分析
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，基础模型可解释性方向
abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) learn rich sequence semantics from vast volume of protein sequences, yet the information encoded in their high-dimensional embeddings remains largely a black box, posing an interpretability challenge. Here we show that semantic features learned by pLMs can be decoded to reveal biologically meaningful signals using coevolutionary analysis without downstream supervised-training. Building on this insight, we developed MaskNGly, a zero-shot framework that identifies protein N-glycosylation sites directly from PLM-embeddings while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art supervised predictors. MaskNGly is computationally efficient and intrinsically transferable, enabling omics-scale characterization of protein glycosylation landscape. Applied across proteomes, it reveals that canonical N-X-S/T motifs gain higher glycosylation propensities with increasing organismal complexity and that glycosylation preferentially occurs at structured, solvent-exposed regions. Mutations altering high-scoring motifs are more frequently disease-associated. The framework also captures signatures of glycosylation-mediated protein allostery. These results establish an interpretable and scalable route to study glycobiology from pLM-embeddings.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质语言模型（protein language models，pLMs）从海量蛋白质序列中学习到丰富的序列语义，但其高维嵌入（embedding）中所编码的信息在很大程度上仍是一个黑箱，带来了可解释性方面的挑战。我们在此表明，借助共进化分析，无需下游监督训练，即可对 pLM 所学到的语义特征进行解码，从而揭示具有生物学意义的信号。基于这一发现，我们开发了 MaskNGly，这是一个零样本（zero-shot）框架，可直接从 PLM 嵌入中识别蛋白质 N-糖基化位点，其性能与最先进的有监督预测器相当。MaskNGly 计算效率高，且具有内在的可迁移性，可用于在组学尺度上刻画蛋白质糖基化图谱。将其应用于多个蛋白质组后发现，随着生物体复杂度的增加，经典的 N-X-S/T 基序获得更高的糖基化倾向，且糖基化优先发生在结构化、溶剂暴露的区域。改变高评分基序的突变与疾病相关的频率更高。该框架还能捕捉到糖基化介导的蛋白质变构的特征。这些结果确立了一条可解释且可扩展的途径，用于基于 pLM 嵌入研究糖生物学。

title: Neural RNA splicing models rely on reading frame information unavailable to the splicing machinery
zh_title: 神经RNA剪接模型依赖剪接机制不可用的阅读框信息
summary: 研究发现常用剪接位点预测网络受改变阅读框的突变影响更大，导致系统性漏检毒性外显子。
key_points: 改变阅读框的缺失或突变影响更大
在框内终止密码子产生时尤为明显
毒性外显子被系统性遗漏，具临床相关性
reason: 对模型机制有洞见的预印本，证据有限
abstract: Deep neural networks can accurately predict RNA splice sites from genomic sequence, but whether they do so by simulating the natural splicing process is unclear. We evaluate this question by examining mutations that should not have a strong effect on splicing, but are correlated with it in the human genome. We focus specifically on mutations that affect frame alignment because this is known to be relevant to machinery that operates spatially and temporally separately from the splicing machinery. We find that predictions made by commonly-used neural tools are impacted far more by deletions or mutations that alter translational reading frame, producing in-frame stop codons, than by those that preserve reading frame. This dependence on reading frame causes these models to systematically miss many poison exons, a clinically relevant category of exons where reading frame is disrupted. This dependence is much weaker in "grey-box" models that build in splicing-specific structure. Our results imply that widely-used black-box models of splicing rely on information that is not accessible to the RNA splicing machinery. Code is available at https://github.com/kavigupta/frame-alignment-checks.
zh_abstract: 深度神经网络能够根据基因组序列准确预测RNA剪接位点，但它们是否通过模拟自然剪接过程来实现这一点尚不清楚。我们通过考察这样一类突变来评估这一问题：这些突变本不应对剪接产生强烈影响，但在人类基因组中与剪接相关。我们特别关注影响读码框对齐的突变，因为已知这与在空间和时间上独立于剪接机制运作的机制相关。我们发现，常用神经网络工具的预测结果受缺失或改变翻译读码框、产生读码框内终止密码子的突变的影响，远大于受保持读码框的突变的影响。这种对读码框的依赖导致这些模型系统性地漏检许多毒性外显子（poison exons），这是一类读码框被破坏、具有临床相关性的外显子。在内置剪接特异性结构的“灰盒”模型中，这种依赖要弱得多。我们的结果表明，广泛使用的黑盒剪接模型依赖于RNA剪接机制无法获取的信息。代码可见 https://github.com/kavigupta/frame-alignment-checks。

title: Cross-cancer knowledge transfer for lymph node metastasis prediction: Applicability of an axillary lymph node-based deep learning model
zh_title: 淋巴结转移预测的跨癌种迁移：腋窝淋巴结深度学习模型的适用性
summary: 用乳腺癌腋窝淋巴结CT训练DenseNet-121集成模型，并在256幅其他癌种淋巴结CT外部数据上评估跨解剖部位泛化。
key_points: 训练集为523例乳腺癌患者的1,128个腋窝淋巴结
采用两种裁剪方式的DenseNet-121集成
外部数据含256幅来自不同原发癌的CT图像
reason: 转移预测有外部集，但样本较小、预印本；转移方向加分
abstract: Evaluation of lymph node (LN) metastasis is critical for cancer staging and treatment planning. Since radiologic hallmarks of metastatic LNs are shared across primary cancers, a computed tomography (CT)-based deep learning (DL) classifier developed from one anatomy may transfer to others. This study built a DenseNet-121 ensemble model using clinical-implication-applied preprocessing and evaluated its cross-anatomical generalizability to LNs from diverse primary cancers. A DenseNet-121 ensemble model combining fixed-size cropping (FSC) and adjustable square cropping (ASC) was trained from ImageNet initialization on an axillary lymph node (ALN) dataset (n = 1,128 from 523 breast cancer patients). The model utilized clinical-implication-applied perinodal cropping with bicubic filtering and standardized resizing. To test cross-anatomical generalizability, an external dataset of 256 CT images across four anatomical regions was evaluated: cervical, mediastinal, upper-abdominal, and lower-abdominal LNs. Perinodal free margins were systematically varied from 10% to 40% to optimize the balance between context preservation and surround interference. Bicubic filtering and standardized resizing yielded the highest internal performance on the original ALN dataset (FSC-ASC ensemble area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUROC] 0.958, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.920-0.987 at 40% margin). The model demonstrated site-dependent, above-chance generalizability across all external regions. Cervical LNs achieved the highest performance at a 40% margin (AUROC 0.939, 95% CI 0.875-0.989). Mediastinal LNs peaked at a 10% margin (AUROC 0.796, 95% CI 0.672-0.903), with wider margins degrading performance due to adjacent structural interference. Upper-abdominal and lower-abdominal LNs reached optimal performance at a 30% margin (AUROC 0.814 for upper; AUROC 0.917 for lower). A single ALN-trained DL model can accurately predict LN metastasis across cervical, mediastinal, and abdominal stations through site-specific perinodal margin tuning. These findings support the feasibility of cross-cancer knowledge transfer and the clinical utility of generalizable backbones for pan-cancer nodal assessment.

title: Evaluating uncertainty for detecting performance loss and guiding deferral after model transfer between hospital systems
zh_title: 医院系统间模型迁移后用不确定性检测性能下降并指导转诊复核
summary: 在MIMIC-IV训练死亡率预测模型并迁移至eICU，发现多种不确定性度量均不能可靠指示性能下降，但可用于选择性复核。
key_points: 熵与互信息等度量未能可靠提示性能下降
推迟熵最高20%病例后剩余错误率降至6.3-8.0%
reason: 跨院迁移的有信息量负面结果，公开数据集，预印本
abstract: Clinical prediction models often perform worse after transfer between hospital systems, but deterioration becomes apparent only once outcomes are known. We investigated whether uncertainty measures available at prediction time warn of performance loss and can help identify individual predictions requiring review. Three neural network architectures were trained on MIMIC-IV for in-hospital mortality prediction and evaluated on eICU-CRD. Measures included predictive entropy, mutual information from Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, and representation density. After transfer, AUROC fell from 0.86-0.87 to 0.76-0.77 and calibration worsened, while entropy and mutual information were lower. None of the measures reliably indicated the reduced performance. Deferring the 20% with the highest entropy reduced the remaining error rate from 17.5-20.1% to 6.3-8.0%; the deferred patients included 91-99% of false alarms but only 2-7% of missed deaths, which carried low uncertainty. Uncertainty therefore supported selective review but failed to reveal performance loss.

title: CARTnet: Template-guided B-cell Epitope Prediction with Contact-aware Attention
zh_title: CARTnet：模板引导、接触感知的B细胞表位预测
summary: 预印本提出CARTnet，融合多模态特征与模板表位信息预测B细胞表位，在内部与外部测试集AUPRC均高于DiscoTope-3、BepiPred等方法。
key_points: 内部测试AUPRC 0.243，高于DiscoTope-3的0.220
外部测试AUPRC 0.267，高于DiscoTope-3的0.192
整合接触感知注意力与模板表位信息
reason: 有外部测试集与基线对比的预印本方法，绝对指标仍较低
abstract: B-cell epitope prediction remains challenging due to the limited availability of experimentally characterized data and the incomplete understanding of antibody-antigen recognition. Here, we present CARTnet, a novel contact-aware deep learning framework that integrates multimodal features and template-derived epitope information. CARTnet demonstrated superior performance when compared to the existing state-of-the-art methods across most evaluation metrics on both the internal and external test datasets. In particular, CARTnet achieved an AUPRC of 0.243 on the internal test set, compared with 0.220 for DiscoTope-3, 0.140 for BepiPred-2, and 0.198 for BepiPred-3. This improvement was also observed on the external test set, where CARTnet achieved an AUPRC of 0.267, compared with 0.192, 0.111, and 0.215 for DiscoTope-3, BepiPred-2, and BepiPred-3, respectively, supporting its generalizability. CARTnet also supports template-guided prediction, in which limited prior epitope information can improve the identification of additional epitope residues; a single template residue increased the AUPRC of the template-based variant from 0.225 to 0.403 on the internal test set. Furthermore, we demonstrated that epitope information from closely related viruses can be transferred across the genus Alphavirus to improve epitope prediction accuracy. These results establish CARTnet as an accurate framework for both de novo and template-guided B-cell epitope prediction.
zh_abstract: 由于经实验表征的数据有限，且对抗体—抗原识别的理解尚不完整，B 细胞表位预测仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出 CARTnet，一种新颖的接触感知深度学习框架，整合了多模态特征和源自模板的表位信息。在内部和外部测试数据集上，CARTnet 在大多数评价指标上均优于现有最先进方法。具体而言，CARTnet 在内部测试集上的 AUPRC 为 0.243，而 DiscoTope-3 为 0.220，BepiPred-2 为 0.140，BepiPred-3 为 0.198。在外部测试集上也观察到这一提升：CARTnet 的 AUPRC 为 0.267，而 DiscoTope-3、BepiPred-2 和 BepiPred-3 分别为 0.192、0.111 和 0.215，支持其泛化能力。CARTnet 还支持模板引导的预测，即有限的先验表位信息可提高对其他表位残基的识别；在内部测试集上，仅一个模板残基即可使基于模板的变体的 AUPRC 从 0.225 提高到 0.403。此外，我们证明了来自近缘病毒的表位信息可在甲病毒属（Alphavirus）内迁移，从而提高表位预测准确性。这些结果表明，CARTnet 是一个可用于从头预测和模板引导 B 细胞表位预测的准确框架。

title: Bridging large language model-based agents and workflow languages for automated multi-perspective analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing data.

abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] In single-cell RNA sequencing data analysis, the same dataset can be examined from multiple complementary perspectives, each requiring different analytical strategies and potentially leading to distinct biological interpretations. Systematically exploring such diverse strategies in a reproducible and scalable manner remains challenging. We developed a framework combining large language model-based agents with workflow languages. Given an objective, the framework generates analytical strategies, converts each into a workflow plan, verifies that each plan reflects its intended strategy, executes accepted workflows in parallel, and integrates the outputs into a final report. Evaluation across three datasets and three large language models showed that plan validation improved the executable analysis intent fulfillment rate from 0.061 to 0.378. Diversity of analytical themes was established at as few as 10 generated strategies, while the number of distinct executable analysis paths grew continuously, reaching 59 unique paths at 100 generated strategies. Parallelization of both plan generation and workflow execution achieved up to a 29.9-fold speedup in workflow execution over sequential execution, with plan generation completing in near-constant time regardless of portfolio size. Source code is available at https://github.com/bioinfo-tsukuba/mpdas_paper under the MIT license.
zh_abstract: [生物信息学进展] 在单细胞RNA测序数据分析中，同一数据集可以从多个互补的角度进行考察，每个角度需要不同的分析策略，并可能得出不同的生物学解释。以可重复且可扩展的方式系统地探索这些多样化策略仍具挑战性。我们开发了一个将基于大语言模型的智能体（agents）与工作流语言相结合的框架。给定一个目标，该框架会生成分析策略，将每个策略转换为工作流计划，验证每个计划是否体现其预期策略，并行执行通过验证的工作流，并将输出整合为最终报告。在三个数据集和三种大语言模型上的评估显示，计划验证使可执行的分析意图达成率从0.061提高到0.378。分析主题的多样性在仅生成10个策略时即已形成，而不同可执行分析路径的数量则持续增长，在生成100个策略时达到59条独特路径。计划生成和工作流执行的并行化使工作流执行相比顺序执行最高实现了29.9倍的加速，而无论策略组合规模如何，计划生成均能在近乎恒定的时间内完成。源代码已在MIT许可下公开，网址为 https://github.com/bioinfo-tsukuba/mpdas_paper。

title: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
zh_title: SphereFlow：基于超球面几何传输的缺失模态插补
summary: 提出SphereFlow，用冻结的自监督编码器将各模态映射到共享超球面潜空间，并用流匹配做几何感知的短程传输来插补缺失模态。
key_points: 将跨模态插补转化为超球面上邻近点间的传输
指出高斯噪声源与线性插值路径和单位范数流形不匹配
针对两类几何冲突做了几何感知修改

abstract: Missing modality imputation aims to synthesize unobserved modalities from observed ones. Existing methods treat each modality as living on its own latent manifold, forcing the generator to learn a long, unstructured jump between them. We present SphereFlow, which takes a fundamentally different view: by projecting all modalities into a shared hyperspherical latent space via a frozen self-supervised encoder, cross-modal imputation reduces to short-range geometric transport between nearby points on the sphere. Realizing this idea with flow matching, however, exposes two geometric conflicts: the standard Gaussian noise source is catastrophically mismatched with the unit-norm data manifold, and the linear interpolation path departs the sphere surface into a region where the decoder has no training signal. We resolve both with simple, geometry-aware modifications: replacing the noise source with the observed-modality latent so that the velocity field learns only the cross-modal displacement, and training the decoder with a time-weighted loss that extends its domain to the near-surface region traversed by the flow. We prove that this data-as-source formulation reduces the worst-case off-manifold deviation from a quantity that grows with the latent dimension to a small, dimension-independent bound governed by inter-modality similarity. Experiments on BraTS multi-modal MRI imputation and CT-MRI translation demonstrate state-of-the-art generation fidelity across all settings, while downstream brain tumor segmentation with our imputed data closes roughly eighty percent of the gap to the full-modality oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/WTHH031230/SphereFlow.
zh_abstract: 缺失模态插补旨在根据已观测模态合成未观测模态。现有方法将每种模态视为位于各自的潜在流形上，迫使生成器学习模态之间漫长且无结构的跳跃。我们提出 SphereFlow，其视角根本不同：通过冻结的自监督编码器将所有模态投影到共享的超球面潜在空间，跨模态插补即可简化为球面上邻近点之间的短程几何传输。然而，用流匹配（flow matching）实现这一思路会暴露两个几何冲突：标准高斯噪声源与单位范数数据流形严重不匹配；线性插值路径会离开球面，进入解码器没有训练信号的区域。我们通过简单且具备几何意识的改进解决了这两个问题：用已观测模态的潜变量取代噪声源，使速度场只需学习跨模态位移；并用时间加权损失训练解码器，将其定义域扩展到流所经过的近表面区域。我们证明，这种以数据为源的形式将最坏情况下偏离流形的程度，从随潜在维度增长的量降低为一个由模态间相似度决定、与维度无关的较小上界。在 BraTS 多模态 MRI 插补和 CT-MRI 转换上的实验表明，我们的方法在所有设置下均达到最先进的生成保真度；同时，使用我们插补的数据进行下游脑肿瘤分割，可弥合与全模态理想情形之间约百分之八十的差距。代码见 https://github.com/WTHH031230/SphereFlow。

title: Artificial intelligence in pediatric allergic diseases: what the clinician needs to know.

summary: 叙述性综述总结AI在儿童哮喘、特应性皮炎、食物过敏等领域的能力与局限，强调临床就绪度及采用算法输出前应提出的问题。

abstract: [European journal of pediatrics] Artificial intelligence (AI) is reaching pediatric practice through consumer apps, wearables and decision-support tools, yet most children with allergic disease are managed by general pediatricians. This review summarizes what AI can and cannot do across pediatric allergic diseases, emphasising clinical readiness and the questions clinicians should ask before acting on an algorithmic output. Narrative review. MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus and Google Scholar were searched for English-language publications (January 2015-June 2026) on machine learning, deep learning, digital biomarkers and large language models in pediatric asthma, wheeze, atopic dermatitis, food allergy and allergic rhinitis. Peer-reviewed studies were appraised for clinical applicability, validation status and implementation barriers. Machine learning trajectory analyses show that allergic disease follows multiple coexisting pathways rather than a single atopic march. Deep learning interprets atopic dermatitis images and respiratory sounds with accuracy approaching specialist assessment. Predictive models estimate oral food challenge outcomes and impending asthma exacerbations, and wearable-derived biomarkers may signal deterioration early. Readiness nevertheless varies widely: most applications remain at research or pilot stage, constrained by small single-center datasets, scarce external validation, under-representation of darker skin tones, and limited interoperability with clinical workflows. AI is closer to the bedside in pediatric allergy than in many other areas of pediatrics, but few tools are ready for autonomous clinical use. No trial has yet shown that acting on an AI-derived risk estimate improves clinical outcomes in children. Pediatricians will increasingly encounter AI-derived outputs brought by families or embedded in health systems; appraising validation, representativeness and accountability is becoming a core clinical skill. • Pediatric allergic diseases follow heterogeneous trajectories that conventional tools predict poorly. • AI models report high accuracy in image, audio, and risk-prediction tasks. • Readiness, not reported accuracy, should govern clinical use: most tools remain research-stage. • Pediatricians need a practical framework to appraise AI outputs brought by families and health systems.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Valvular Heart Disease: A Bibliometric and Knowledge-Mapping Analysis Revealing a Three-Phase Evolution Toward Integrated Clinical Intelligence.

abstract: [British journal of hospital medicine (London, England : 2005)] The application of artificial intelligence (AI) in valvular heart disease (VHD) has advanced significantly in recent years. However, a systematic evaluation of this field's historical development, knowledge structure, and global research patterns has yet to be conducted. This paper aims to outline the global evolution of AI research in VHD utilizing bibliometric and knowledge-mapping methods. Publications related to AI and VHD from 1991 to 2025 were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection database to investigate research progress. CiteSpace software was employed for bibliometric and knowledge mapping analyses, assessing indicators such as publication trends, keyword networks, collaboration patterns, co-citation relationships, and emerging topics. A total of 3291 pieces of literature were identified. Research productivity remained low until the year before 2004, followed by steady growth and a sharp increase after 2015, culminating in 461 articles by the end of 2025. Network analysis revealed three sequential stages: image-assisted applications, prediction modeling, and recent advancements in deep-learning-based integrated systems. The United States accounted for the largest research volume, while England and Germany served as core nodes in the international cooperation network. Co-citation analysis identified significant clinical guidelines and pioneering interventional studies as key intellectual pillars in this domain. Over the past 35 years, significant progress has been achieved, transitioning from computer systems used solely for image analysis to more integrated clinical applications. Currently, deep learning techniques are increasingly prevalent, accompanied by a focus on multimodal data integration and a stronger linkage between computational methods and clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: [British journal of hospital medicine (London, England : 2005)] 近年来，人工智能（AI）在瓣膜性心脏病（VHD）中的应用取得了显著进展。然而，针对该领域的历史发展、知识结构和全球研究格局，尚未有系统评估。本文旨在利用文献计量学和知识图谱方法，概述 VHD 领域 AI 研究的全球演变。从 Web of Science 核心合集数据库检索 1991 年至 2025 年与 AI 和 VHD 相关的出版物，以考察研究进展。采用 CiteSpace 软件进行文献计量和知识图谱分析，评估发文趋势、关键词网络、合作模式、共被引关系和新兴主题等指标。共纳入 3291 篇文献。2004 年之前研究产出一直较低，此后稳步增长，2015 年后急剧增加，至 2025 年底达到 461 篇。网络分析揭示了三个相继的阶段：影像辅助应用、预测建模，以及近期基于深度学习的集成系统方面的进展。美国的研究数量最多，而英格兰和德国是国际合作网络中的核心节点。共被引分析确定了重要的临床指南和开创性的介入研究是该领域的关键知识支柱。在过去 35 年中，该领域取得了显著进展，已从仅用于图像分析的计算机系统转变为更为综合的临床应用。目前，深度学习技术日益普遍，同时更加关注多模态数据整合，以及计算方法与临床决策之间更紧密的联系。

title: Automated Detection of Positioning Errors in Bitewing Radiographs Using Deep Learning.

abstract: [Clinical and experimental dental research] Bitewing radiographs (BWs) are essential diagnostic tools in dentistry, but are often affected by positioning errors, compromising their diagnostic value and increasing retake rates. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a deep learning-based automated system for detecting and classifying BW type (premolar/molar), side (right/left), and common positioning errors in a controlled mannequin-based setting. A total of 403 BWs were collected from dental student assessments acquired from dental radiology mannequins. BWs were consensus-labeled by dentomaxillofacial radiology experts for type, side, and the most common positioning errors. A balanced data set supported training and validation. Convolutional neural network architectures, including ResNet and DenseNet variants, were trained from scratch and evaluated as independent classification tasks using stratified fivefold cross-validation. Performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and area under the curve, reported as mean ± standard deviation across folds. A confusion matrix was generated for multi-class cone-cutting error (CCE) severity classification. The system achieved accuracies of 95.8% for BW type classification, 99.0% for side classification, 96.3% for CCE detection, and 93.4% for interproximal overlap detection. Multi-class CCE classification achieved an accuracy of 79.3%, with reliable identification of "critical" and "minimal" errors. Detection of incorrect receptor placement achieved an accuracy of 73.2%. The CNN-based system showed strong performance for bitewing type, side, binary cone-cutting error, and interproximal overlap classification in mannequin-acquired radiographs. Performance was more limited for multi-class cone-cutting severity and incorrect receptor placement. These findings support the potential use of deep learning for radiographic quality assessment in education and quality-control workflows. A validation study using patient-acquired bitewing radiographs from clinical settings is required before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract:
【背景】咬合翼片（bitewing radiographs，BWs）是牙科中重要的诊断工具，但常受到投照位置错误的影响，从而降低其诊断价值并增加重拍率。本研究旨在开发并评估一种基于深度学习的自动化系统，用于在受控的模型人（mannequin）环境中检测并分类 BW 类型（前磨牙/磨牙）、侧别（右/左）以及常见的投照位置错误。
【方法】共收集 403 张 BW，来自牙科学生考核中使用牙科放射学模型人所获得的影像。BW 由口腔颌面放射学专家就类型、侧别和最常见的投照位置错误达成共识并进行标注。一个平衡的数据集用于训练和验证。包括 ResNet 和 DenseNet 变体在内的卷积神经网络架构从头开始训练，并采用分层五折交叉验证作为独立的分类任务进行评估。性能以准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 分数和曲线下面积进行评估，以各折的平均值±标准差报告。针对多分类的锥形束切割错误（cone-cutting error，CCE）严重程度分类生成了混淆矩阵。
【结果】该系统在 BW 类型分类中的准确率为 95.8%，侧别分类为 99.0%，CCE 检测为 96.3%，邻面重叠检测为 93.4%。多分类 CCE 分类的准确率为 79.3%，可可靠识别“严重”和“轻微”错误。错误接收器放置的检测准确率为 73.2%。
【结论】基于 CNN 的系统在模型人所获影像中对咬合翼片类型、侧别、二分类锥形束切割错误和邻面重叠分类表现良好。对多分类锥形束切割严重程度和错误接收器放置的性能较为有限。这些发现支持深度学习在教学和质量控制流程中用于放射影像质量评估的潜力。在临床部署之前，需要使用临床环境中患者咬合翼片开展验证研究。

abstract: [Southern medical journal] Artificial intelligence (AI) is used increasingly to support clinical care and documentation in health care, including patient rehabilitation. AI is used to increase efficiency, facilitate information transfer, and improve accuracy and consistency in assessment and treatment of medical conditions. AI can assist clinicians in correlating symptoms, tracking patient progress, and recommending evidence-based treatment protocols. This article first provides perspectives on the role of AI in managing lateral epicondylosis. It then embarks on a preliminary study that compares expert opinions with AI recommendations for evaluation and treatment and provides insight into how patient expectations are influenced by AI searches in comparison to clinician recommendations. Although AI offers the potential of valuable support, clinicians remain responsible for final decisions to ensure optimal patient outcomes. The role of AI continues to evolve in clinical practice. It holds promise for advancing standards in the nonoperative management of lateral epicondylosis with the caveat that clinicians-human beings-have the ultimate responsibility and accountability for appropriate application and decision making to thoughtfully care for patients and improve treatment outcomes.

title: Enhancing medical image segmentation with HCE-Net: A heterogeneous feature collaborative extraction network.

summary: 提出双路径异构编码的分割网络HCE-Net，含融合Sobel边缘先验与多尺度卷积的正交融合模块。

abstract: [PloS one] Medical image segmentation occupies a pivotal role in clinical diagnosis and therapeutic planning. Conventional segmentation techniques struggle to accommodate the intricate representational attributes of medical images, while prevailing deep learning segmentation models predominantly adopt homogeneous single encoders and linear feature fusion paradigms, thereby exhibiting inherent limitations in contextual modeling, fine-grained feature excavation, and contour segmentation accuracy. To address such dilemmas, this paper proposes a Heterogeneous Collaborative Feature Extraction Network (HCE-Net). Establishing a dual-path heterogeneous encoding architecture, this network excavates complementary feature representations in a parallel manner. An Orthogonal Fusion Module (OFM) is elaborately devised to integrate Sobel edge priors with multi-scale convolutions, enabling the precise capture of edge and contour characteristics. A Diversified Receptive Field Module (DFM) is constructed to consolidate multi-scale detail manifestations and preserve global contextual cues. Furthermore, Adaptive Aggregation Connection (AAC) is embedded within skip connection branches to supplant conventional simplistic concatenation, efficaciously mitigating the technical bottleneck of heterogeneous feature fusion. Comparative experiments conducted on three publicly accessible medical datasets, encompassing dental radiographs, pulmonary CT scans, and retinal vascular images, demonstrate that HCE-Net substantially elevates segmentation accuracy, enhances boundary integrity, and ameliorates the general robustness of the model. It manifests distinguished application prospects across diverse medical image segmentation scenarios.
zh_abstract: [PloS one] 医学图像分割在临床诊断和治疗规划中占据关键地位。传统分割技术难以适应医学图像复杂的表征特性，而目前主流的深度学习分割模型多采用同质的单一编码器和线性特征融合范式，因此在上下文建模、细粒度特征挖掘和轮廓分割精度方面存在固有局限。针对上述难题，本文提出异构协同特征提取网络（HCE-Net）。该网络建立双路径异构编码架构，以并行方式挖掘互补的特征表示。精心设计了正交融合模块（OFM），将Sobel边缘先验与多尺度卷积相结合，从而精确捕获边缘和轮廓特征。构建了多样化感受野模块（DFM），以整合多尺度细节表现并保留全局上下文线索。此外，在跳跃连接分支中嵌入自适应聚合连接（AAC），以取代传统的简单拼接，有效缓解异构特征融合的技术瓶颈。在三个公开可得的医学数据集（包括牙科X线片、肺部CT扫描和视网膜血管图像）上进行的对比实验表明，HCE-Net显著提高了分割精度，增强了边界完整性，并改善了模型的总体鲁棒性。它在多种医学图像分割场景中展现出突出的应用前景。

title: Fairness Metrics based on the AUC in Clinical Predictive AI
zh_title: 临床预测AI中基于AUC的公平性指标
summary: 预印本审视文献中八种基于AUC的公平性指标，指出AUC的不可压缩性使分组与总体AUC不可直接比较，并分析各指标的估计目标及解释问题。
key_points: 考察八种AUC公平性指标，含xAUC等
AUC非可压缩，分组与总体值不可直接比较
将指标与总体AUC分解关联以界定估计量
reason: 方法学讨论有价值，但为预印本，无临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Fairness evaluation of clinical prediction models for binary outcomes often involves fairness metrics that compare the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, or c-statistic) across subgroups. However, the AUC has been shown to be a non-collapsible metric, meaning that its subgroup specific and overall values are not directly comparable as often implicitly assumed. This raises important questions about how existing AUC-based fairness metrics should be used and interpreted. We examine eight AUC-based fairness metrics proposed in the literature, including: within-group AUC parity; cross-group AUC (xAUC) parity; gap-to-overall AUC; equity-scaled AUC; minimum-based metrics; $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$; $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$; and $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ or $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ parity. We characterise their estimands, relate them to the decomposition of overall AUC (into within- and cross-group components), and critically appraise them. We then illustrate their behaviour using simulations based on the EuroSCORE II, a clinical prediction model for in-hospital mortality. We recommend reporting an AUC matrix, containing the overall AUC and all within- and cross-group AUC components, alongside population characteristics. When fairness metrics are needed, we recommend reporting the within-group AUC parity, with cross-group AUC parity providing supplementary information but requiring caution due to its potential conflict with calibration. Metrics involving $\mathrm{xAUC}^1$ and $\mathrm{xAUC}^0$ have merit, summarising within- and cross-group AUCs into single values, but their interpretation is non-trivial, and they should be used with caution. Gap-to-overall AUC, equity-scaled AUC, and minimum-based metrics compare quantities that should not be compared and it is unclear how to operationalise them, making them not fit for purpose and generally not recommended.
zh_abstract: 针对二分类结局的临床预测模型的公平性评估，常涉及比较各亚组受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC，即c统计量）的公平性指标。然而，AUC已被证明是一种不可折叠（non-collapsible）的指标，即其亚组特异性值与总体值之间并不能像通常隐含假设的那样直接比较。这对现有基于AUC的公平性指标应如何使用和解释提出了重要问题。我们考察了文献中提出的八种基于AUC的公平性指标，包括：组内AUC均等（within-group AUC parity）；跨组AUC（xAUC）均等；与总体AUC的差距（gap-to-overall AUC）；公平性缩放AUC（equity-scaled AUC）；基于最小值的指标；$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$；$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$；以及$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$或$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$均等。我们刻画了它们的估计目标（estimand），将其与总体AUC的分解（分为组内和跨组成分）联系起来，并进行了批判性评价。随后，我们基于EuroSCORE II（一种院内死亡率临床预测模型）的模拟来说明它们的表现。我们建议报告AUC矩阵，其中包含总体AUC及所有组内和跨组AUC成分，并同时报告人群特征。当需要公平性指标时，我们建议报告组内AUC均等，跨组AUC均等可提供补充信息，但由于其可能与校准相冲突，需谨慎使用。涉及$\mathrm{xAUC}^1$和$\mathrm{xAUC}^0$的指标有一定价值，可将组内和跨组AUC汇总为单一数值，但其解释并不简单，应谨慎使用。与总体AUC的差距、公平性缩放AUC和基于最小值的指标比较的是不应被比较的量，且不清楚如何将其付诸实施，因此不适用，通常不推荐。

title: 3D Banff Glomerulitis Scoring for Kidney Transplant Pathology: Feasibility Study for Volumetric Quantification
zh_title: 肾移植病理3D Banff肾小球炎评分：体积量化可行性研究
summary: 提出3D Banff评分框架，对连续切片对齐、重建肾小球身份并在三维中整合炎症细胞计数，探索体积量化的可行性。
key_points: 对齐连续切片并跨深度重建肾小球身份
设计Compatible、Volumetric、去重Volumetric三种评分
以g评分为例应用于移植肾多切片活检
reason: 可行性研究，样本信息有限；病理方向略上调
abstract: Quantifying glomerular inflammation in kidney-transplant biopsies is traditionally performed on single whole-slide sections using the Banff "most-severe section" rule, despite the inherently three-dimensional nature of lesion distribution. This 2D based assessment might lead to instability when inflammation varies across slices. This paper reports a feasibility study examining the technical feasibility and clinical relevance of extending Banff scoring into three dimensions. To this end, we propose a 3D Banff lesion-scoring framework that aligns serial sections, reconstructs glomerular identities across depth, and integrates inflammatory-cell counts in 3D under three scoring strategies: Compatible, Volumetric, and Deduplicated Volumetric. In the experiments, glomerulitis (g-scores) was used as an example Banff metric and applied to multi-section renal allograft biopsies. Our findings indicate that 3D Banff g-scores are more consistent across sections and, under the semi-automatic setting, the Volumetric strategy correlates more strongly with clinical biomarkers than traditional 2D scores. These results show that 3D volumetric quantification offers promising added value, underscoring the potential benefit of 3D-aware Banff scoring for kidney transplant pathology.

title: Text-Only Domain Adaptation for Low-Resource Medical ASR: Shallow Fusion and Density Ratio Rescoring for Hausa
zh_title: 低资源豪萨语医疗ASR的纯文本领域自适应
summary: 以固定MMS-1B声学模型，比较浅层融合与密度比重打分，两者将豪萨语医疗语音WER从29.56%降至约23.5%。
key_points: 4-gram语言模型由19,421条健康句子训练
250条录音，10名说话人
SF与DRA间差异不显著
reason: 小规模语音评估，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often struggle with specialised medical vocabulary, especially in low-resource languages where domain-specific speech data are scarce. We investigate text-only domain adaptation for Hausa medical ASR using the fixed MMS-1B-FL102 acoustic model and two decoding-time language-model fusion methods: Shallow Fusion (SF) and the Density Ratio Approach (DRA). A 4-gram KenLM trained on 19,421 Hausa health sentences serves as the medical target model, while a 75,372-sentence general-domain model provides the source prior for DRA. Evaluation uses 250 recordings of 25 physician-reviewed prompts from 10 speakers across six northern Nigerian states. Under prompt-disjoint five-fold cross-validation, SF and DRA reduce WER from 29.56% to 23.55% and 23.33%, respectively. Both significantly outperform greedy decoding (p < 0.001), while their difference is not significant (p = 0.423). However, general-LM-only SF achieves 23.96% WER, indicating that the medical LM's additional improvement over a general LM is modest. Medical Term Error Rate also improves under fusion, but does not establish a distinct medical-domain advantage. These findings demonstrate that lightweight, text-only language-model fusion can improve Hausa medical ASR without additional domain-specific speech collection.
zh_abstract: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统常常难以处理专业的医学词汇，在缺乏领域特定语音数据的低资源语言中尤其如此。我们使用固定的MMS-1B-FL102声学模型和两种解码阶段语言模型融合方法——浅层融合（Shallow Fusion，SF）和密度比方法（Density Ratio Approach，DRA），研究豪萨语医学ASR的纯文本领域适应。以19,421条豪萨语健康句子训练的4-gram KenLM作为医学目标模型，而75,372句的通用领域模型为DRA提供源先验。评估使用来自尼日利亚北部六个州10名说话人对25条经医师审核提示语的250段录音。在提示语不相交的五折交叉验证下，SF和DRA分别将WER从29.56%降至23.55%和23.33%。两者均显著优于贪婪解码（p < 0.001），而两者之间的差异不显著（p = 0.423）。然而，仅使用通用语言模型的SF取得23.96%的WER，表明医学语言模型相对通用语言模型的额外改进有限。融合后医学术语错误率也有所改善，但并未确立明确的医学领域优势。这些结果表明，轻量级的纯文本语言模型融合可以在无需额外采集领域特定语音的情况下改善豪萨语医学ASR。

title: When can multi-fragment 2D/3D registration be trusted? Calibrated certification and uncertainty-driven view planning for pelvic fracture fluoroscopy
zh_title: 骨盆骨折透视多碎片2D/3D配准的可信认证与视角规划
summary: 提出闭环配准框架，给出校准的误差界并标记不可信碎片，规划下一视角；在60例模拟骨折CT上评估。
key_points: 95%误差界覆盖83%未标记碎片
第二视图起仍有14%误差超5mm
仅为模拟透视评估
reason: 仅模拟数据的预印本，无临床验证
abstract: Registering a segmented CT to fluoroscopy can locate every fracture fragment but can guide surgery only when trusted. After each shot, our closed loop registers all fragments, bounds their errors with a calibrated sandwich covariance, flags implausible or ambiguous ones, and stops or plans the next view. On simulated fluoroscopy of 60 held-out fracture CTs with realistic image uncertainty, 95% bounds covered 83% of unflagged fragments and 91% of those within 5mm, but from the second view on 14% failed by over 5mm, a third with bounds of at most 2mm. A fragment's shift when a view was added separated tightly bounded failures best (exploratory; AUC 0.94, bound 0.81). Requiring that the newest view moved no fragment beyond its bound, preferred post hoc, lowered false stops at 2mm from 23% to 6% overall, with 345 instead of 362 correct ones but more trajectories uncertified; delaying the stop did not, and other signals at equal acceptance left 10-15% false. With a segmentation error shared by all views (median Dice 0.89), 21% of this rule's stops were false against 10% without it (15 cases; exploratory). Minimax planning certified sooner than the clinical protocol without the check (4.20 versus 4.72 shots, Holm p <0.001), but no criterion reached the pre-specified endpoint, a true 2mm error, significantly sooner, even in the true basin. On real fluoroscopy of five intact pelves no 2mm certificate was false. Trust takes evidence across views, not only a calibrated local bound.
zh_abstract: 将已分割的CT与透视图像配准可以定位每个骨折碎片，但只有在可信时才能指导手术。每次拍摄后，我们的闭环系统会配准所有碎片，用校准的三明治协方差（sandwich covariance）界定其误差，标记不合理或模糊的碎片，并决定停止或规划下一个视角。在对60例留出骨折CT、含真实图像不确定性的模拟透视上，95%误差界覆盖了83%未被标记的碎片，以及其中5 mm以内碎片的91%；但从第二个视角起，仍有14%的碎片误差超过5 mm，其中三分之一的误差界不超过2 mm。增加一个视角时碎片的位移最能区分误差界很紧的失败情形（探索性分析；AUC 0.94，误差界0.81）。要求最新视角未使任何碎片移动超过其误差界（事后优选），可将2 mm时的误判停止率总体上从23%降至6%，正确认证数为345例而非362例，但未获认证的轨迹更多；延迟停止则无此效果，而在相同接受率下其他信号仍有10%–15%的误判。当所有视角共有分割误差（Dice中位数0.89）时，该规则下21%的停止为误判，而无此规则时为10%（15例；探索性分析）。极小化极大（minimax）规划比无此检查的临床方案更早完成认证（4.20对4.72次拍摄，Holm校正P<0.001），但没有任何标准能显著更早达到预先设定的终点，即真实2 mm误差，即使在真实收敛域内亦然。在五个完整骨盆的真实透视上，没有出现错误的2 mm认证。信任需要跨视角的证据，而不仅仅是经过校准的局部误差界。

title: CAPTOR: text-encoder-free grounding by counting caption co-occurrence over the visual words of a frozen encoder
zh_title: CAPTOR：基于冻结视觉编码器的无文本编码器图文定位
summary: 预印本提出CAPTOR，在不使用文本编码器的情况下，通过统计标题词与冻结图像编码器视觉词的共现来估计词-图块匹配矩阵，适用于仅用切片训练的病理类编码器。
key_points: 将冻结编码器的图块聚类为视觉词
用标题共现差异构建词签名
在COCO、VOC上领先无训练基线
reason: 新颖预印本方法，有基线对比；医疗相关性仅为病理动机，证据有限
abstract: Grounding a text query in an image needs a matrix scoring every term against every patch. Vision-language models compute it with an aligned text encoder, which many image encoders, such as histopathology-related models trained on slides alone, lack. The Caption-Anchored Patch-Term Occurrence Representation (CAPTOR) estimates the matrix without a text encoder. It clusters a frozen image encoder's patch tokens into visual words and describes each captioned image by its share of patches in each word. A term signature is the standardized difference of those shares between images whose captions mention the term and the rest. The matrix factorizes into a term-by-word table and a query-independent image factor, so an image is encoded once and a new term adds one table row. Against every training-free baseline, CAPTOR leads on Common Objects in Context (COCO), Pascal Visual Object Classes (VOC) and Cityscapes. On COCO, scored on the cells one object owns, it reaches 0.565 mean intersection over union (mIoU) against 0.502. On all three, it is also level with a text alignment trained on the same backbone, which needs gradients, a text encoder and several times the captions. On held-out breast-cancer slides, it exceeds the strongest baseline scoring patches with a pathology text encoder by 0.160 mIoU. Read through CAPTOR, UNI, an encoder trained on slides alone, exceeds such baselines by 0.132 on a common grid. Counting can therefore give a text interface to any image encoder trained without language, wherever captioned images exist.
zh_abstract: 将文本查询定位到图像中，需要一个对每个术语与每个图像块进行打分的矩阵。视觉-语言模型借助对齐的文本编码器来计算该矩阵，而许多图像编码器（如仅用玻片训练的组织病理学相关模型）并不具备这样的文本编码器。基于图注锚定的图像块-术语出现表示（CAPTOR）无需文本编码器即可估计该矩阵。它将冻结图像编码器的图像块token聚类为视觉词，并以每张带图注图像中各视觉词所占图像块比例来描述该图像。术语签名是图注提及该术语的图像与其余图像之间这些比例的标准化差值。该矩阵可分解为术语-视觉词表和与查询无关的图像因子，因此图像只需编码一次，新增一个术语只需增加表中一行。与所有免训练基线相比，CAPTOR在Common Objects in Context（COCO）、Pascal Visual Object Classes（VOC）和Cityscapes上均领先。在COCO上，针对单一物体所占单元格评分，其平均交并比（mIoU）达到0.565，而基线为0.502。在这三个数据集上，它也与基于同一骨干网络训练的文本对齐方法持平，后者需要梯度、文本编码器以及数倍的图注数据。在留出的乳腺癌玻片上，它比使用病理学文本编码器对图像块打分的最强基线高出0.160 mIoU。通过CAPTOR来解读，仅用玻片训练的编码器UNI在同一网格上比此类基线高出0.132。因此，只要存在带图注的图像，计数就能为任何未经语言训练的图像编码器提供文本接口。

title: A Primer on Radiomics for the Practicing Orthopaedic Surgeon.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews
zh_title: 面向骨科医生的影像组学入门
summary: 该综述面向骨科医生，介绍AI在骨科中的应用，包括临床决策支持、结局预测及医学影像定量特征提取（影像组学）。
key_points: AI涵盖计算机视觉、语言模型与预测分析
机器学习模型可预测术后功能结局、住院时长与并发症
重点介绍影像组学的定量特征提取
reason: 泛泛入门综述，属增量档，综述上限低
abstract: [Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews] Artificial intelligence (AI) is permeating many aspects of daily life. Medicine, and specifically orthopaedic surgery, is being influenced by the rapid growth and success of AI in serving as an adjunct to medical expertise. AI includes many nested subfields and applications such as computer vision, language models, and predictive analytics. Using standard machine learning methods, clinical decision support tools are being developed for clinicians to provide evidence-based, individualized care. Some models predict clinical and functional outcomes after a procedure, whereas others may incorporate administrative metrics to predict factors, such as length of stay, return to the emergency department, and complications. The application of AI to medical imaging focuses on the extraction of a large amount of quantitative data in the form of predefined features from clinical images that humans cannot perceive, a field known as radiomics. There has been recent interest, particularly in oncology, to apply radiomics to aid in diagnosis and prognostication of outcomes. Given the robust growth of radiomics literature, and the anticipated application in orthopaedic surgery, the purpose of this review article is to educate the orthopaedic surgery community on the practical importance and the basics of radiomics.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews] 人工智能（AI）正渗透到日常生活的诸多方面。医学，尤其是骨科手术，正受到AI快速发展及其作为医学专业知识辅助手段所取得成功的影响。AI包含许多嵌套的子领域和应用，如计算机视觉、语言模型和预测分析。利用标准机器学习方法，目前正在开发供临床医生使用的临床决策支持工具，以提供循证的个体化医疗。一些模型可预测手术后的临床和功能结局，而另一些模型可能纳入管理指标，以预测住院时长、返回急诊科以及并发症等因素。AI在医学影像中的应用侧重于从临床图像中以预定义特征的形式提取大量人眼无法感知的定量数据，这一领域称为影像组学（radiomics）。近来，尤其是在肿瘤学领域，人们对应用影像组学辅助诊断和预后判断产生了兴趣。鉴于影像组学文献的强劲增长及其在骨科手术中的预期应用，本综述旨在使骨科手术界了解影像组学的实际重要性和基本知识。

title: An Application of the Self-Determination Theory Model for AI-Enhanced, Digital Psychosocial Interventions for Pediatric Disabilities.
source: PubMed · Western journal of nursing research
zh_title: 自我决定理论在儿科残障AI增强数字心理干预中的应用
summary: 论文将自我决定理论用于指导儿科护士使用AI增强的数字心理社会干预，面向发育障碍青少年。
key_points: 针对发育障碍青少年的心理社会需求
指出此类AI干预常缺乏理论基础
以理论驱动的综合方式映射应用
reason: 理论性泛论，无实证，增量档
abstract: [Western journal of nursing research] Youth with developmental disabilities (DDs) experience elevated psychosocial challenges, including difficulties with emotion regulation, self-concept, and access to timely mental health support. Pediatric nurses are well-positioned to address these needs; however, time constraints, limited training, and restricted access to specialty services often impede the provision of consistent psychosocial care. Digitally delivered psychosocial interventions enhanced by artificial intelligence (AI) offer new opportunities for individualized, accessible support, but these approaches frequently lack a clear theoretical foundation. This paper applied Self-Determination Theory (SDT), specifically Basic Psychological Needs Theory, to guide pediatric nurses' use of AI-enhanced, digital psychosocial interventions for DDs in practice. A theory-driven synthesis mapped SDT needs (autonomy, competence, and relatedness) to AI-enabled intervention features: conversational agents, neuro/adaptive feedback, and emotion-recognition tailoring. The framework specifies how these features can promote volitional engagement, optimal challenge with timely feedback, and supportive interactions for youth with DDs. It also notes evidence gaps (small, heterogeneous samples; limited comparisons and follow-up) and barriers involving payment/workload, equity and access, and data protection, transparency, and bias. SDT offers a coherent, testable foundation for designing, evaluating, and integrating AI-enhanced psychosocial supports for pediatric DDs. Nurses can screen for support, coach families, monitor risks, and advocate for ethical deployment and rigorous research.

abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] Clinical microbiology laboratories face persistent pressure to shorten turnaround times, reduce manual workloads, and standardize diagnostic workflows. Total laboratory automation (TLA) and artificial intelligence (AI) are complementary responses to these demands. In this review, we examine how the evidence base for automation and AI in clinical microbiology is distributed along a maturity gradient and what this distribution implies for the next phase of implementation. Available evidence indicates that automated platforms shorten culture turnaround times and reduce manual workload in observational and multi-center studies, although the scale of benefit depends on specimen type and workflow configuration. Automated reading, identification, and susceptibility testing systems showed high concordance with manual standards for common specimen types, with error rates below commonly cited acceptability thresholds. Evidence for AI performance in plate reading and resistance prediction is abundant; however, most models remain in an assistive phase without prospective validation. Randomized trials of rapid testing and automation rarely demonstrate overall clinical superiority, and patient-oriented benefits remain limited and inconsistent. Guidelines provide directional support, whereas interoperability, quality control, and regulatory frameworks are still under development. The priority of the field is not additional single-center performance validation. The next phase requires multi-center prospective verification, interpretability, standardization, and comparative evidence with clinical outcomes as endpoints. AI-assisted evidence tools may accelerate evidence generation, although their utility remains preliminary.

abstract: In this paper, we propose Dual-VaDE, an unsupervised generative framework for learning interpretable anatomical prototypes from unlabeled medical images. In contrast to previous variational methods that rely on a single spatial latent code, which often entangles global geometry with local textures and fails to capture their cross-domain dependencies, Dual-VaDE introduces a dual-domain Gaussian mixture prior that explicitly couples spatial anatomy with phase-preserving Fourier spectral representations. We derive an exact, closed-form variational lower bound that fuses this joint prior into the decoder and optimizes the entire network end-to-end via an alternating EM formulation, avoiding heuristic two-stage clustering while ensuring superior training stability and robustness. Evaluated on OASIS-3 brain MRI, Dual-VaDE delivers substantially sharper and more plausible prototypes, achieves superior cluster separation with improvements of up to 94% over spatial-only baselines, exhibits markedly reduced variance across random seeds, and incurs negligible inference overhead (0.28 ms per image).

abstract: Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compared a quantum-kernel support vector machine (QSVM; 4 qubits, tuned bandwidth) and a variational quantum classifier (VQC) with five tuned classical models across six public clinical datasets. All models used identical four-component inputs and 25 cross-validation splits. Paired AUROC differences were assessed using a corrected resampled t-test, Holm-adjusted equivalence tests (margins: +/-0.02 and +/-0.05), and random-effects pooling. Ablation, noise, finite-shot, and implementation-fault analyses were conducted. We propose QML-Health-READY, an eight-domain reporting framework. Results: Neither quantum model significantly outperformed any classical comparator. Pooled across datasets, QSVM differed from the kernel-matched radial basis function (RBF) SVM by -0.006 AUROC (95% CI: -0.017 to +0.004), equivalent to +/-0.02. VQC differed from the best classical model by -0.007 (95% CI: -0.019 to +0.004). QSVM was equivalent to RBF SVM within +/-0.05 in four of six datasets but was significantly worse than the best classical model on NHANES 2017-18 (-0.076). A classically trivial product-state kernel performed as well as the entangling kernel. With depolarizing noise (p = 0.01) and 1,024 shots per kernel entry, QSVM AUROC decreased by 0.054 (95% CI: 0.036 to 0.071). Untuned bandwidth produced near-chance AUROC (0.48-0.59). Conclusions: Correctly configured quantum classifiers approached but did not exceed tuned classical models. Finite-shot estimation, rather than gate noise, was their main practical cost, while configuration errors could reverse conclusions. QML-Health-READY defines reporting requirements for credible claims.
zh_abstract: 【背景】量子机器学习（QML）被推崇用于临床预测，但其与经典模型的比较很少采用配对设计，也很少进行等效性检验。【方法】我们在六个公开临床数据集上，将量子核支持向量机（QSVM；4个量子比特，带宽已调优）和变分量子分类器（VQC）与五种经过调优的经典模型进行比较。所有模型均使用相同的四分量输入和25次交叉验证划分。配对AUROC差异采用校正重采样t检验、Holm校正的等效性检验（等效界值：±0.02和±0.05）以及随机效应合并进行评估。同时开展了消融、噪声、有限次测量（finite-shot）和实现错误分析。我们提出了QML-Health-READY，一个包含八个领域的报告框架。【结果】两种量子模型均未显著优于任何经典对照模型。在各数据集合并后，QSVM与核匹配的径向基函数（RBF）SVM的AUROC相差-0.006（95% CI：-0.017至+0.004），在±0.02范围内等效。VQC与最佳经典模型相差-0.007（95% CI：-0.019至+0.004）。QSVM在六个数据集中的四个数据集上与RBF SVM在±0.05范围内等效，但在NHANES 2017-18上显著差于最佳经典模型（-0.076）。一个在经典计算中平凡可实现的乘积态核表现与纠缠核相当。在去极化噪声（p = 0.01）且每个核矩阵元素1,024次测量的条件下，QSVM的AUROC下降了0.054（95% CI：0.036至0.071）。未调优的带宽导致AUROC接近随机水平（0.48-0.59）。【结论】配置正确的量子分类器可接近但未超过经过调优的经典模型。有限次测量估计而非门噪声是其主要的实际代价，而配置错误可能使结论发生逆转。QML-Health-READY为可信的结论主张规定了报告要求。

abstract: [Bioinformatics advances] Amyloids are predominantly β-sheet-rich, stable protein structures that can maintain their presence in the human body for multiple years. Amyloid protein aggregates contribute to the development of multiple neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and Huntington's, and are involved in different vital functions, such as memory formation and immune system function. Here, we used advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques to predict amyloid propensity from the amino acid sequence. First, we aggregated labeled amino acid sequence data from multiple sources, obtaining a roughly balanced dataset of 2365 sequences for binary classification. We leveraged that data to both fine-tune the ESM2 model and to train new models based on protein embeddings from ESM2 and UniRep. The predictions from these models were then unified into a single soft voting ensemble model, yielding highly robust and accurate results. We further made a tool where users can provide the amino acid sequence and get the amyloid formation probabilities of different segments of the input sequence. Users can access the light version of AmyloDeep through the web server at https://amylodeep.com/, and the full model is available as a Python package at https://pypi.org/project/amylodeep/.

abstract: Background/Objectives: CNNs perform well in retinal disease classification from spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT), but whether EfficientNet's natural-image scaling hierarchy transfers to medical-image transfer learning at fixed resolution remains unclear. This study evaluates EfficientNet-B0-B7 for four-class SD-OCT classification and accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. Methods: Eight ImageNet-pretrained variants (4.05-64.10M instantiated backbone parameters) were evaluated at 224x224 on the Kermany dataset. Grayscale images were replicated to RGB and processed using model-embedded preprocessing and augmentation. Training comprised frozen-backbone head training followed by partial fine-tuning. Metrics covered classification, discrimination, efficiency, and visual analyses. Results: Test accuracy varied non-monotonically from 95.93% (B0) to 96.95% (B1); B7 achieved 96.73%. B1 had the highest accuracy and Drusen F1 (0.8780), while B7 had Drusen F1 of 0.8720 and the highest Drusen recall (0.9177). Drusen had the lowest F1 across all variants and contributed 82.2% of the summed squared deviation in class-specific F1; class ranking remained Normal > CNV > DME > Drusen. The OCT accuracy ranking differed from the reported ImageNet hierarchy, where B7 ranked first. The accuracy-to-parameter ratio fell from 19.82 to 1.48 percentage points per million total parameters. The final train-test gap had a weak, non-significant association with test accuracy (r = 0.26, p = 0.53). Conclusions: Larger EfficientNet variants did not consistently improve SD-OCT classification. B1 achieved the highest accuracy and Drusen F1, whereas B7 showed a secondary accuracy recovery at greater model size and CPU latency, indicating task and protocol dependent scaling effects. As cross-partition duplicates have not been independently audited, results are conditional on the supplied split.

abstract: [Frontiers in molecular biosciences] Bone Morphogenetic Protein 4 (BMP4), a member of the transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-β) superfamily, plays pivotal roles in embryonic development, tissue homeostasis, and disease pathogenesis-including cancer, fibrosis, and fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP). The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) methodologies over the past 5 years has created unprecedented opportunities for understanding and therapeutically targeting BMP4 biology at multiple scales, from atomic-resolution structure prediction to population-level clinical prognostication. This review systematically examines the intersection of BMP4 biology and AI across three core domains: (1) AI-driven drug discovery targeting BMP4 signaling pathways, (2) deep learning-based protein structure prediction and computational modeling of BMP4 and its receptor complexes, and (3) clinical AI applications for BMP4-associated diseases. A narrative review with systematic search elements was conducted across PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, bioRxiv, and arXiv for English-language publications from 2020 to 2026, supplemented by targeted searches via Semantic Scholar. Included studies were categorized as BMP4-specific, BMP receptor/BMP-pathway-targeted, or transferable AI methodology not yet applied to BMP4. We find that AI has accelerated BMP4-related research along multiple axes, though with important caveats. AlphaFold3 and related tools have generated high-confidence predicted models of BMP4-receptor complex architecture, aspects of which were previously intractable to experimental structure determination; these predictions remain to be fully validated experimentally. ML-guided virtual screening has identified first-in-class BMP pathway (receptor) modulators for FOP, although BMP4-specific small-molecule modulators have not yet been identified computationally. abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] Craniomaxillofacial subunit transplantation represents one of the most technically demanding reconstructive strategies for repairing anatomical subunit defects involving the cranium, mandible, maxilla, orbital cavity and nose. Conventional reconstructive approaches are hindered by inherent limitations in personalized anatomical matching, dynamic tissue adaptability, and long-term therapeutic efficacy. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and four-dimensional (4D) bioprinting has revolutionized craniomaxillofacial reconstructive surgery. This review summarizes state-of-the-art advances in AI-enabled 4D bioprinting for craniomaxillofacial subunit repair, covering core application scenarios including bone defect regeneration, facial soft tissue and cutaneous organ reconstruction, peripheral neural regeneration, and vascularized composite tissue fabrication. We elaborate the synergistic potential of AI and 4D bioprinting in craniomaxillofacial subunit reconstruction, and dissect critical bottlenecks including inadequate material performance, low precision of shape deformation programming, and limited clinical translatability of existing AI models. This work provides valuable insights for further translational research of AI-integrated 4D bioprinting in craniomaxillofacial subunit reconstruction.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology] 颅颌面亚单位移植是修复涉及颅骨、下颌骨、上颌骨、眼眶和鼻部的解剖亚单位缺损时技术要求最高的重建策略之一。传统重建方法受限于个体化解剖匹配、动态组织适应性和长期治疗效果方面的固有局限。人工智能（AI）与四维（4D）生物打印的结合已经革新了颅颌面重建外科。本综述总结了AI赋能的4D生物打印用于颅颌面亚单位修复的最新进展，涵盖骨缺损再生、面部软组织和皮肤器官重建、周围神经再生以及带血管复合组织制造等核心应用场景。我们阐述了AI与4D生物打印在颅颌面亚单位重建中的协同潜力，并剖析了关键瓶颈，包括材料性能不足、形状变形编程精度低，以及现有AI模型的临床转化能力有限。本工作为AI整合的4D生物打印在颅颌面亚单位重建中的进一步转化研究提供了有价值的见解。
